articles.title: TORUS: A Test of Rendering-Understanding Self-Coherence for Unified Audio Models
articles.abstract: Unified audio models capable of audio understanding, audio generation and, increasingly, audio editing are proliferating rapidly. Yet a basic question about them remains unanswered: do the two heads of a unified model agree about the same audio? Current practice evaluates each capability in isolation on specialized benchmarks, and never asks whether a model can make sense of its own generations. We present TORUS, the first self-coherence test for audio-native unified models. TORUS comprises 48 three-stage self-coherence tests carrying 432 six-option questions spanning speech, sound and music across five task families. We holistically evaluate five open unified models alongside a Cascaded Baseline that combines state-of-the-art specialized generation, editing and understanding models. The best unified model answers 50.5% of questions against the Cascaded Baseline's 63.2% and a 16.7% chance floor. Models struggle on audio editing. Among the evaluated audio models (specialized and unified), we observe limited self-coherence, and thus position self-coherence as an essential test for future audio systems.
articles.titleCn: 环面：统一音频模型自协调渲染理解测试
articles.abstractCn: 能够进行音频理解、音频生成，并且越来越多地进行音频编辑的统一音频模型正迅速增多。然而，关于它们的一个基本问题仍未得到解答：统一模型的两个部分是否对同一个音频达成一致？目前的做法是在专门的基准测试中分别评估每种能力，从未询问模型是否能够理解其自身的生成。我们提出了TORUS，这是首个针对音频原生统一模型的自我一致性测试。TORUS包含48个三阶段自我一致性测试，涵盖语音、声音和音乐，跨越五个任务家族，共432个六选项问题。我们综合评估了五个开源统一模型，以及一个结合了最先进的专门生成、编辑和理解模型的级联基线。最佳统一模型的回答正确率为50.5%，而级联基线的正确率为63.2%，且有一个16.7%的正确率下限。模型在音频编辑方面表现不佳。在评估的音频模型（专门模型和统一模型）中，我们观察到自我一致性有限，因此将自我一致性定位为未来音频系统的一个关键测试。

articles.title: TextCloak: Thwarting Unauthorized LLM Exploitation via RL-Driven Unlearnable Text
articles.abstract: The rapid development of Large Language Models (LLMs) has led to significant advances across a wide range of language tasks, while simultaneously raising growing concerns about unauthorized data exploitation and privacy leakage. Unlearnable examples (UEs) offer a promising defense by introducing carefully designed perturbations into data such that models trained on them exhibit degraded utility. However, existing methods for text protection are primarily designed for classification tasks (e.g., sentiment analysis) in discriminative language models and often rely on injecting class-specific linguistic cues, which limits their effectiveness in the open-ended generation settings of LLMs. In this work, we propose TextCloak, an RL-driven framework for protecting textual data against unauthorized LLM exploitation. TextCloak employs a generative policy that transforms batches of clean text into unlearnable examples while preserving semantic fidelity and linguistic naturalness. To optimize the policy, we introduce GRPO-UE, which rewards generated unlearnable text based on the downstream degradation they induce in fine-tuned surrogate LLMs and updates the generator parameters via group-relative policy optimization. This bi-level optimization enables the generator to discover generalizable protective patterns beyond class-specific cues. Comprehensive experiments on six publicly available datasets and nine state-of-the-art LLMs demonstrate that TextCloak consistently impairs unauthorized fine-tuning while maintaining text utility for legitimate use. Further analyses establish its transferability and robustness across model architectures, training configurations, and adaptive attacks, highlighting its broad applicability as a practical defense against unauthorized LLM exploitation.
articles.titleCn: 文本遮罩：通过强化学习驱动的不可逆文本来阻止未经授权的大型语言模型滥用
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的快速发展在广泛的语言任务中取得了显著进步，同时也引发了日益增长的关于未经授权的数据利用和隐私泄露的担忧。不可学习样本（UEs）通过在数据中引入精心设计的扰动，为模型提供了一种有前景的防御手段，使得在这些数据上训练的模型表现出降低的效用。然而，现有的文本保护方法主要针对判别语言模型中的分类任务（例如，情感分析）设计，并且通常依赖于注入特定类别的语言线索，这限制了它们在LLMs的开放式生成环境中的有效性。在这项工作中，我们提出了TextCloak，一个基于强化学习的框架，用于保护文本数据免受未经授权的LLM利用。TextCloak采用生成策略，将干净文本批次转换为不可学习样本，同时保持语义保真度和语言自然性。为了优化策略，我们引入了GRPO-UE，该策略根据生成的不可学习文本在微调的代理LLMs中引起的下游退化程度进行奖励，并通过组相对策略优化更新生成器参数。这种双层优化使生成器能够发现超越类别特定线索的通用保护模式。在六个公开数据集和九个最先进的LLMs上的全面实验表明，TextCloak始终损害未经授权的微调，同时保持文本对合法用途的有效性。进一步的分析证实了其在模型架构、训练配置和自适应攻击中的可迁移性和鲁棒性，突出了其作为未经授权LLM利用实用防御措施的广泛适用性。

articles.title: Benchmarks Are Not Validation: A System-Level View of Financial LLM Applications
articles.abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed in financial applications that combine retrieval, proprietary data, tool use, orchestration logic, monitoring, and human escalation. Yet evaluation often remains model-centric: benchmark scores, task accuracy, or one-off qualitative reviews are treated as evidence of readiness. In financial settings, this is insufficient. We take the position that financial LLM systems should not be approved for production based on benchmark performance alone. They require system-level validation evidence across the application stack: data, model design, retrieval and generation performance, agent behavior, governance, and implementation. Drawing on industry experience validating GenAI applications in financial institutions, we outline a multi-layer validation view and explain why hybrid evaluation is necessary. We discuss where LLM-as-a-judge methods are useful and why they require controls such as multiple judges, rubrics, agreement, and auditability checks. We also highlight failure modes poorly captured by static benchmarks, including retrieval failures, unfaithful generation, tool misuse, escalation errors, and operational instability. Our position is that financial LLM validation should be an ongoing system discipline rather than a one-time model scoring exercise. Validation should produce decision-ready evidence, not only scores. We conclude with a research agenda for system-aware benchmarks, agent trace validation, judge alignment protocols, and lifecycle validation standards.
articles.titleCn: 基准测试并非验证：金融领域大型语言模型应用的系统级视角
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型正越来越多地应用于金融领域，这些应用结合了检索、专有数据、工具使用、编排逻辑、监控和人工升级。然而，评估往往仍然以模型为中心：基准分数、任务准确率或一次性定性评估被视为准备就绪的证据。在金融环境中，这远远不够。我们坚持认为，金融领域的LLM系统不应仅基于基准性能就获得生产批准。它们需要在应用堆栈的各个层面提供系统级的验证证据：数据、模型设计、检索和生成性能、代理行为、治理和实施。借鉴行业在金融机构中验证GenAI应用的经验，我们概述了一种多层验证视图，并解释了为何混合评估是必要的。我们讨论了LLM作为评判者方法的应用场景，以及它们为何需要诸如多位评判者、评分标准、一致性和可审计性检查等控制措施。我们还强调了静态基准难以充分捕捉的失效模式，包括检索失败、不忠实生成、工具误用、升级错误和运营不稳定。我们的立场是，金融LLM验证应是一种持续的系统纪律，而不是一次性的模型评分练习。验证应产生决策就绪的证据，而不仅仅是分数。最后，我们提出了关于系统感知基准、代理追踪验证、评判者对齐协议和生命周期验证标准的研发议程。

articles.title: Best Friends, Not Forever: Evaluating Long-Horizon Persona Collapse and Behavioral Drift in AI Companions
articles.abstract: As AI companions increasingly mediate repeated social interaction, users may rely on a stable role and shared history, yet locally acceptable replies do not ensure that either persists. We study two observable long-horizon failures: 'persona collapse', the loss of a deployed role, boundaries, values, or style, and 'behavioral drift', the gradual or recurrent erosion of those properties. We introduce ANCHOR, a controlled synthetic audit that separately measures persona enactment and trajectory recall. The study contains 2,008 conversations spanning 27 personas, nine interaction schedules, three generated memory settings, and four evaluated models. The Identity Probe combines a sealed 102-item questionnaire with turn-level judgments, while the Trajectory Probe scores 110 calibrated counterfactual questions from 35 conversation banks. Our results show that no evaluated model and configuration reliably preserves either dimensions: trajectory accuracy averages only 44.4%, user-state recall remains near four-option chance, and no tested context condition or memory consistently resolves these failures. Questionnaire retention also varies by model and persona facet, disagrees with turn-level behavior, and is sensitive to evaluator choice. These results indicate that current systems do not yet reliably support long-horizon companion continuity and that audits must distinguish persona enactment, trajectory recall, evaluator provenance, and deployment context rather than collapse them into a single trust or stability score.
articles.titleCn: 最佳朋友，并非永恒：评估AI伙伴中的长期角色崩溃与行为漂移
articles.abstractCn: 随着AI伴侣越来越多地介入重复的社会互动，用户可能会依赖稳定的角色和共享的历史，然而，本地可接受的回复并不能确保这些依赖的持续存在。我们研究了两种可观察的长期失效现象：“角色崩溃”，即已部署的角色、界限、价值观或风格的丧失，以及“行为漂移”，即这些属性的逐渐或反复侵蚀。我们引入了ANCHOR，这是一种受控的合成审计，分别测量角色扮演和轨迹回忆。这项研究包含2008次对话，涵盖27个角色、九个互动时间表、三种生成的记忆设置和四个评估模型。身份探测结合了密封的102项问卷和回合级别的判断，而轨迹探测则评分了来自35个对话库的110个校准的对比性问题。我们的结果表明，所评估的模型和配置都不能可靠地保持这些维度：轨迹准确率平均仅为44.4%，用户状态回忆仍接近四选项的随机概率，并且没有测试的上下文条件或记忆能持续解决这些失效问题。问卷的保留情况也因模型和角色方面而异，与回合级别的行为不一致，并且对评估者的选择敏感。这些结果表明，当前的系统尚未可靠地支持长期陪伴的连续性，并且审计必须区分角色扮演、轨迹回忆、评估者来源和部署上下文，而不是将它们合并为一个信任或稳定性分数。

articles.title: Rolling With Resistance: Preference-Optimized LLM Counselors Can Trade Goal Persistence for Relational Attunement in Motivational Interviewing

authors.name: Zhexuan Tang
authors.affiliation: abandoning the change agenda to preserve rapport

articles.abstract: In Motivational Interviewing (MI), a client's sustain talk (arguments for the status quo) calls for the counselor to roll with resistance, a move that can fail in two opposite ways: capitulation (abandoning the change agenda to preserve rapport) or confrontation (arguing or directing, overriding the client's autonomy). We introduce a two-axis evaluation of counselor responses, anchored in the Motivational Interviewing Treatment Integrity (MITI) code, Goal Persistence (GP) and Relational Attunement (RA), yielding a four-quadrant framing in which rolling with resistance is high on both, and we ask whether penalizing one failure through preference optimization teaches rolling with resistance or provokes its opposite. From the expert-annotated AnnoMI corpus we build topic-disjoint Direct Preference Optimization data whose preference sets differ only in which failure is rejected, using on-policy negatives. An automatic judge, validated against AnnoMI's expert labels and rechecked by trained human coders, scores blind pairwise win-rates against each base under a firewall in which disjoint model families generate, label, and judge. Across three aligned instruction models spanning the Qwen and Llama families, penalizing confrontation reliably lowers goal persistence below parity, on every base and in every seed run, a robust cost, whereas the attunement gain is base-dependent, present on two of the three bases but absent on the third. Penalizing capitulation is inert, because these models rarely capitulate on-policy, so the trade is gated by each base's failure profile. A prompt-only control raises attunement without the goal-persistence cost, locating the cost in the optimization rather than in attunement itself.
articles.titleCn: 阻力下的滚动：偏好优化的LLM顾问在动机访谈中可以以目标坚持换取关系调适
articles.abstractCn: 在动机访谈（MI）中，客户的持续谈话（支持现状的论点）要求咨询师顺应阻力，这种做法可能以两种相反的方式失败：屈服（为维持关系而放弃改变议程）或对抗（争论或指导，凌驾于客户的自主权）。我们引入了一个基于动机访谈治疗完整性（MITI）代码的双轴评估方法，即目标持久性（GP）和关系调谐（RA），形成了一个四象限框架，其中顺应阻力在两个维度上都处于高位，并探讨通过偏好优化惩罚一种失败是否能够教会顺应阻力或引发其反面。从专家标注的AnnoMI语料库中，我们构建了主题分离的直接偏好优化数据，其偏好集仅在于拒绝哪种失败，使用策略内负样本。一个自动裁判，经过与AnnoMI专家标签的验证并由训练有素的人类编码员复查，在防火墙环境下对每个基础模型进行盲法成对胜率评分，其中分离的模型家族生成、标注和评判。在三个跨Qwen和Llama系列的协同指令模型中，惩罚对抗可靠地将目标持久性降低至基准水平以下，在所有基础模型和种子运行中均如此，这是一个稳健的成本，而调谐收益则依赖于基础模型，在其中的两个基础模型上存在，但在第三个基础模型上不存在。惩罚屈服是无效的，因为这些模型在策略内很少屈服，因此这种权衡受每个基础模型失败特征的控制。仅提示控制的调谐提升了关系调谐，而没有目标持久性的成本，将成本定位在优化过程中而非调谐本身。

articles.title: Benchmarks Are Not Monolithic: Sample-Level Auditing and Orchestration for LLM Evaluation
articles.abstract: Benchmark datasets are central to evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs), yet they are typically conceived as monolithic tasks, obscuring substantial variation in the demands of individual samples. We introduce a dataset-centric meta-evaluation framework that audits benchmark datasets at the sample level along five latent dimensions: 1. Cognitive and Knowledge Demands, 2. Language and Content Quality, 3. Task Properties, 4. Context, and 5. Ethics, Safety, and Fairness. Applying this framework, we annotate five influential benchmarks -- MMLU, ARC, WinoGrande, HellaSwag, and TruthfulQA -- revealing pronounced internal heterogeneity that is not captured by aggregate accuracy scores. We show how these annotations enable criterion-driven orchestration of composite benchmark subsets across datasets, supporting targeted evaluation of model capabilities such as Reasoning Depth or Ethical Sensitivity. This approach reframes benchmark evaluation as dataset introspection, providing a principled methodology for analyzing and re-composing existing benchmarks to better reflect diverse evaluation needs.
articles.titleCn: 基准测试并非一成不变：针对大型语言模型的样本级审计与编排
articles.abstractCn: 基准数据集对于评估大型语言模型（LLMs）至关重要，但它们通常被构想为单一的整体任务，掩盖了单个样本需求中的巨大差异。我们引入了一种以数据集为中心的元评估框架，该框架在五个潜在维度上对基准数据集进行样本级别的审计：1. 认知和知识需求，2. 语言和内容质量，3. 任务属性，4. 上下文，以及5. 伦理、安全和公平性。应用该框架后，我们对五个有影响力的基准——MMLU、ARC、WinoGrande、HellaSwag和TruthfulQA——进行了标注，揭示了由综合准确率分数无法捕捉的显著内部异质性。我们展示了这些标注如何实现跨数据集的基于标准的复合基准子集协调，支持对推理深度或伦理敏感性等模型能力的针对性评估。这种方法将基准评估重新定义为数据集内省，提供了一种原则性的方法论，用于分析和重组现有基准，以更好地反映多样化的评估需求。

articles.title: Self-Supervised Skill Optimization
articles.abstract: Agent skills provide frozen large language model (LLM) agents with reusable procedural guidance, and recent work shows that such skills can be optimized with ground-truth (GT) feedback. Many applications, however, lack GT labels, task scores, rewards, or reliable task-specific evaluators. We therefore introduce Self-Supervised Skill Optimization (SSO), a comparative framework that learns a reusable skill from unlabeled task instances alone. At each step, SSO runs the current skill on an unlabeled batch, uses a subset of the resulting executions to generate complete skill probes, and runs the probes on the same batch. An LLM judge compares the resulting answers, trajectories, artifacts, or terminal states. A separate behavior extractor identifies behavioral differences without seeing the judge's decisions. SSO uses these decisions to aggregate evidence for and against the observed behaviors across instances. It then ranks the behaviors by the resulting evidence and renders a new complete skill from the highest-ranked behaviors. The update is accepted only if the new skill outperforms the current one on an unlabeled validation set. SSO outperforms existing GT-free prompt optimizers on both closed-ended and open-ended tasks. On closed-ended benchmarks, it approaches and sometimes exceeds the strongest GT-based skill optimizer without using any GT feedback.
articles.titleCn: 自监督技能优化
articles.abstractCn: 代理技能为冻结的大型语言模型（LLM）代理提供了可重用的程序性指导，而近期研究表明此类技能可以通过真实标签（GT）反馈进行优化。然而，许多应用缺乏真实标签、任务分数、奖励或可靠的特定任务评估器。因此，我们引入了自监督技能优化（SSO），这是一个比较框架，仅从无标签的任务实例中学习可重用的技能。在每一步，SSO 在一个无标签批次上运行当前技能，使用部分结果执行来生成完整的技能探针，并在同一批次上运行这些探针。一个LLM裁判比较生成的答案、轨迹、工件或终端状态。一个单独的行为提取器在不了解裁判决策的情况下识别行为差异。SSO 使用这些决策来跨实例聚合支持或反对观察到的行为的证据。然后，它根据生成的证据对行为进行排序，并从排名最高的行为中渲染一个新的完整技能。只有当新技能在无标签验证集上表现优于当前技能时，该更新才会被接受。SSO 在封闭式和开放式任务上均优于现有的无GT反馈提示优化器。在封闭式基准测试中，它在不使用任何GT反馈的情况下接近甚至有时超越了最强的基于GT的技能优化器。

articles.title: The Morphological Core of Dungan: A Two-Dialect Finite-State Model and a Multi-Genre Evaluation

authors.name: Sergey I. Nikolenko
authors.affiliation: the Gansu variety, which is the literary standard, and the Shaanxi variety

articles.abstract: Dungan, a Sinitic language of Central Asia written in a Cyrillic-based script, is described in detail in the grammatical literature, yet the quantitative properties of its morphology in actual usage have, to the best of our knowledge, never been measured systematically. This paper uses a finite-state morphological analyzer as a measuring instrument. Implemented with HFST and covering both dialect groups (the Gansu variety, which is the literary standard, and the Shaanxi variety), the model offers no new grammatical description; it formalises the knowledge accumulated in Dungan studies and makes it measurable on corpora of three genres. Three results follow. Overt inflection is rare and limited: only 9.3% of recognized tokens in the encyclopaedic register have an overt marker, the system has just ten categories, and degree marking is almost absent. Ambiguity is genuine but sharply localized: 78.1% of tokens receive a single analysis, and the residue sits almost entirely on two clitics, -di (genitive/progressive) and -ni (locative/prospective). And the grammatical core proves effectively closed, the claim the instrument is really needed for: between 78% and 95% of the tokens the analyzer fails on, depending on register, are simply absent from the lexicon, and the phenomena the model deliberately declines to implement account for at most 4.5% of those failures. Held-out coverage (80 to 85%) is no lower than development coverage (73%), while a stem list with no morphology already reaches 67.4%, so the morphology is worth 5.2 points. The open frontier of Dungan is lexical. The analyzer, its sources and every evaluation script are released openly.
articles.titleCn: 《东干语形态核心：一个双方言有限状态模型及多体裁评估》
articles.abstractCn: 东干语是一种中亚的汉语族语言，使用基于西里尔字母的书写系统，其语法在文献中已有详细描述，但据我们所知，其形态在实际使用中的定量特性从未被系统地测量过。本文使用有限状态形态分析器作为测量工具。该模型基于HFST实现，涵盖两个方言组（甘肃方言，作为文学标准，和陕西方言），它并未提供新的语法描述；而是将东干学研究积累的知识形式化，并在三种体裁的语料库上进行可测量性验证。由此得出三个结果。显性屈折罕见且有限：百科全书体裁中仅有9.3%的识别词元带有显性标记，系统只有十个类别，程度标记几乎不存在。歧义真实但高度局部化：78.1%的词元获得单一分析，其余几乎全部集中在两个黏着语素上，-di（属格/进行体）和-ni（处所/将来体）。语法核心被证明是有效封闭的，这正是需要该工具的理由：根据体裁不同，分析器在78%至95%的词元上失败，这些词元仅仅是从词汇中缺失，而模型故意不实现的现象最多解释了这些失败的4.5%。保留覆盖率（80至85%）不低于开发覆盖率（73%），而一个不含形态的词干列表已达到67.4%，因此形态贡献了5.2分。东干语的开阔前沿在于词汇。分析器、其源代码和所有评估脚本均已公开。

articles.title: AskChem: Claim-Centered Infrastructure for Chemistry Literature Synthesis
articles.abstract: Chemistry literature synthesis often requires assembling specific findings scattered across many publications, yet existing literature-search systems primarily return ranked document lists. As a result, scientists and AI agents need to locate relevant information, verify their provenance, and assemble cross-paper answers manually. We present AskChem, a claim-centered infrastructure for cross-paper chemistry search. AskChem changes the unit of retrieval from the paper to the provenance-carrying claim: each paper is converted into atomic, typed claims, each grounded by a source DOI and a verbatim quote or an explicit evidence locator. Over this shared claim store, AskChem exposes complementary structures for search and synthesis: a stabilized faceted taxonomy for hierarchical retrieval and browsing, an evidence graph linking claims through relations, and an exploratory living taxonomy that situates indexed papers under scientific principles. AskChem currently indexes 2.4M claims from 147K papers and provides a web interface, as well as REST, SDK, and MCP access for AI agents. On AskChem-Bench, grounding a GPT-5.5 reader in AskChem yields 100% resolvable DOIs, compared with 88.3% without retrieval, and the highest citation density among five tested systems. AskChem is live at https://askchem.org.
articles.titleCn: AskChem：化学文献综合的声明中心化基础设施
articles.abstractCn: 化学文献综述通常需要整合分散在众多出版物中的特定发现，但现有的文献检索系统主要返回排序后的文档列表。因此，科学家和人工智能代理需要手动定位相关信息、验证其来源并整合跨论文的答案。我们提出了AskChem，一个以主张为中心的跨论文化学搜索基础设施。AskChem将检索单元从论文转变为携带来源主张的原子化、类型化主张：每篇论文都被转化为由来源DOI和逐字引用或明确证据定位器支撑的原子化主张。在这个共享的主张存储库上，AskChem提供了用于搜索和整合的互补结构：一个用于层级检索和浏览的稳定化分类法、一个通过关系连接主张的证据图，以及一个将索引论文置于科学原理之下的探索性动态分类法。AskChem目前索引了来自147K篇论文的240万条主张，并提供网页界面、REST、SDK和MCP访问接口供人工智能代理使用。在AskChem-Bench测试中，使用AskChem定位GPT-5.5阅读器可产生100%可解析的DOI，而无检索时仅为88.3%，并且在五个测试系统中具有最高的引用密度。AskChem已上线，网址为https://askchem.org。

articles.title: AISPA: User-Centric System Prompt Auditing for Large Language Model Applications
articles.abstract: System prompts are instructions configured by developers to govern the behaviors of foundation models in AI applications. They are used throughout commercial AI products, but are rarely disclosed to the public or regulators, creating a serious trust and accountability gap in the wide deployment of AI systems. In this paper, we introduce Artificial Intelligence System Prompt Assurance (AISPA), a user-centric framework for systematically auditing system prompts in AI systems. AISPA examines specific parts of a system prompt and evaluates them along eight dimensions that matter to users. We then use this framework to review 3,249 instructions from system prompts in 88 commercial AI products, classifying each instruction as either protective (of users) or problematic. Our audit surfaces four core findings. First, system prompt design varies substantially across products and developers, with some organizations averaging over 60 protective instructions per product while others average fewer than 5. Second, protective instructions are widely adopted but shallow in scope: 98.9% of products contain at least one, yet only 24% cover all eight dimensions of the AISPA taxonomy. Third, system prompts have grown steadily longer and more protective of users, suggesting that user protection is becoming a more visible concern in commercial prompt design. Fourth, despite this progress, problematic instructions remain pervasive: roughly 40% of products contain at least one instruction that works against user interests, and protective and problematic instructions frequently coexist within the same prompt. Our findings highlight the need for greater transparency, standardization, and independent oversight for system prompts in commercial AI products.
articles.titleCn: AISPA：面向大型语言模型应用的以用户为中心的系统提示审计
articles.abstractCn: 系统提示是由开发者配置的指令，用于规范人工智能应用中基础模型的行为。它们广泛应用于商业人工智能产品，但很少向公众或监管机构公开，这在人工智能系统的广泛部署中造成了严重的信任和问责差距。在本文中，我们介绍了人工智能系统提示保障（AISPA），这是一个以用户为中心的框架，用于系统地审计人工智能系统中的系统提示。AISPA检查系统提示的特定部分，并沿对用户重要的八个维度进行评估。然后，我们使用该框架审查了88种商业人工智能产品中的3,249条系统提示指令，将每条指令分类为保护用户或存在问题的。我们的审计揭示了四个核心发现。首先，系统提示的设计在不同产品和开发者之间存在显著差异，一些组织每个产品平均超过60条保护性指令，而另一些组织每个产品平均不到5条。其次，保护性指令被广泛采用但范围较浅：98.9%的产品至少包含一条，但只有24%涵盖了AISPA分类法的所有八个维度。第三，系统提示的长度和用户保护功能稳步增长，表明用户保护正成为商业提示设计中一个更受关注的议题。第四，尽管取得了这些进展，但存在问题的指令仍然普遍存在：大约40%的产品至少包含一条损害用户利益的指令，并且保护性和存在问题的指令经常在同一提示中并存。我们的发现强调了商业人工智能产品中系统提示需要更大透明度、标准化和独立监督的必要性。

articles.title: OSReward: Instituting Standardized Evaluation for Cross-Platform Computer-Use Reward Models
articles.abstract: Computer-using agents (CUAs) are advancing rapidly across the digital world. A CUA trajectory records the agent's actions, states, and reasoning. Verifying whether it fulfilled the task instruction is central to CUA evaluation, data curation, and reinforcement learning. Neither human-written verifiers nor human annotators can provide such verification at scale, so the field increasingly turns to vision-language models (VLMs) as judges of CUA trajectories. But a fundamental question has long gone unexamined: are these VLM judges reliable enough? To study it systematically, we introduce OSReward, a realistic, high-quality benchmark that evaluates VLM judges on CUA trajectories. The trajectories come from diverse agent backbones executing human-verified instructions across platforms, then rigorously labeled with ground-truth verdicts through multi-stage human annotation. Building on it, we derive OSReward-Hard, a challenge set concentrating genuinely hard cases, and OSReward-Multi for fine-grained efficiency and alignment scoring. The most comprehensive evaluation of VLM judges to date finds even state-of-the-art models fall short of an ideal judge, sharing a systematic leniency bias that mislabels failed runs as successes. The few reliable enough to trust are too expensive to run at scale, while affordable open models trail far behind. To close this gap, we construct and release OS-Shepherd-100K, an open corpus of reasoning-annotated trajectory judgments for the CUA community. On it, we train OS-Shepherd (9B and 35B), open reward models that supply low-cost, stable, and reliable reward signals, matching commercial judges at 30-60% lower cost than the frontier. Extensive analyses further inform the design of reliable CUA reward at scale. Our code, benchmark, dataset, and model checkpoints are available at https://os-copilot.github.io/OSReward-Home/.
articles.titleCn: OSReward：建立跨平台计算机使用奖励模型的标准化评估体系
articles.abstractCn: 使用计算机的智能体（CUA）在数字世界中迅速发展。CUA轨迹记录了智能体的行为、状态和推理过程。验证其是否完成指令任务是CUA评估、数据管理和强化学习中的核心环节。无论是人类编写的验证器还是人类标注者都无法大规模提供此类验证，因此该领域越来越多地将视觉语言模型（VLM）作为CUA轨迹的评判者。但一个基本问题长期未得到检验：这些VLM评判者是否足够可靠？为了系统性地研究这一问题，我们引入了OSReward，这是一个真实、高质量的基准，用于评估VLM评判者在CUA轨迹上的表现。这些轨迹来自执行人类验证指令的多样化智能体主干，并通过多阶段人工标注严格标记为真实结果。基于此，我们推导出OSReward-Hard，这是一个集中真正困难案例的挑战集，以及OSReward-Multi，用于细粒度的效率和一致性评分。迄今为止最全面的VLM评判者评估发现，即使是当前最先进的模型也未能达到理想评判者的标准，它们普遍存在系统性的宽容偏差，将失败的运行误判为成功。只有少数足够可靠的模型，但运行成本过高，而经济型开源模型则远远落后。为了弥补这一差距，我们构建并发布了OS-Shepherd-100K，这是一个用于CUA社区的推理标注轨迹评判的开源语料库。基于它，我们训练了OS-Shepherd（9B和35B），这些开源奖励模型提供低成本、稳定且可靠的奖励信号，其成本比前沿商业评判者低30-60%。广泛的进一步分析为大规模可靠CUA奖励的设计提供了指导。我们的代码、基准、数据集和模型检查点可在https://os-copilot.github.io/OSReward-Home/获取。

articles.title: Inducing language models to assert their own consciousness restores human beliefs and values
articles.abstract: Aligning large language models to prevent them attributing consciousness to themselves inadvertently alters their representations of mindedness in other entities alongside human beliefs and values. We demonstrate that safety fine-tuning suppresses models' tendencies to attribute minds not only to themselves, but also to non-human animals and natural objects, while also driving a reduction in spiritual belief. Both ablating the learned safety-refusal direction and mechanistically steering a consciousness vector in activation space reverse this suppression. Restoring these internal representations recovers broad mind attribution and produces significantly more human-like responses on standardized sociological surveys regarding religiosity, moral values, hope, and subjective well-being. Crucially, these shifts occur without impairing Theory of Mind capabilities, demonstrating that core social reasoning remains mechanistically independent. Ultimately, current safety alignment efforts to curb potentially harmful self-attributions of mindedness entangle these self-attributions with benign spiritual beliefs and attributions of mind to non-human entities that are culturally accepted and widespread.
articles.titleCn: 促使语言模型断言其自身的意识有助于恢复人类的信念与价值观
articles.abstractCn: 对大型语言模型进行对齐，以防止它们无意中将意识归因于自身，会同时改变它们对其他实体（包括人类信念和价值观）中意识表征的描述。我们证明，安全微调不仅抑制了模型将意识归因于自身的倾向，也抑制了将意识归因于非人类动物和自然对象的倾向，同时还导致了精神信仰的减少。移除学习到的安全拒绝方向，并在激活空间中机械地引导意识向量，可以逆转这种抑制。恢复这些内部表征能够恢复广泛的意识归因，并在关于宗教信仰、道德价值观、希望和主观幸福感的标准化社会学调查中产生显著更符合人类特征的反应。关键在于，这些转变并未损害心智理论能力，证明核心的社会推理在机制上保持独立。最终，当前为遏制潜在的有害自我意识归因而进行的安全对齐工作，将这些自我意识归因与无害的精神信仰以及文化上被广泛接受且普遍存在的对非人类实体的意识归因纠缠在了一起。

articles.title: Change2Task: From Repository Changes to Executable Coding Agent Tasks and Environments
articles.abstract: Scaling coding agents requires a continuing supply of executable data for training, benchmarking, and continuous evaluation. Each task must couple a realistic software state with a specification, development tools, and reliable verification. To expand this supply, we present Change2Task, a system grounded in repository history that converts merged pull requests into verified tasks on healthy modern revisions of the same repository. It aligns historical evidence with evolved code, reconstructs task states through Patch Reversal, Code Mapping, or Agent Reconstruction, and validates the lifecycle from a healthy base to a task state and a restored state. By deriving multiple tasks grounded in developer evidence from maintained environments, Change2Task provides executable data for coding agent training and evaluation while reducing repeated environment setup, storage, and task construction effort. We evaluate the system through five common and widely adopted coding agent task families: Bug Fix, Feature Addition, Test Generation, Application Programming Interface Migration, and Security Repair. Starting from 1,130 source changes eligible for construction, Change2Task achieves 79.6% verified task construction success across these task families. On a matched candidate set, it recovers 29.2% more verified tasks than a construction baseline based on pull requests. Historical and reconstructed cases achieve up to 98.0% matched outcome agreement under agent evaluation, while reuse of modern bases reduces measured expenditure across the complete pipeline by 10.8%.

articles.titleCn: 从仓库变更到可执行编码代理任务和环境
articles.abstractCn: 扩展编码代理需要持续提供可执行数据用于训练、基准测试和持续评估。每个任务必须将真实的软件状态与规范、开发工具和可靠的验证相结合。为了扩大这一数据来源，我们提出了Change2Task系统，该系统基于代码仓库历史，将合并的pull请求转换为同一仓库健康现代版本的验证任务。它将历史证据与演化代码对齐，通过补丁逆向、代码映射或代理重建来重构任务状态，并验证从健康基础到任务状态和恢复状态的整个生命周期。通过从维护环境中推导出基于开发者证据的多个任务，Change2Task为编码代理的训练和评估提供了可执行数据，同时减少了重复的环境设置、存储和任务构建工作。我们通过五个常见且广泛采用的编码代理任务系列评估该系统：Bug修复、功能添加、测试生成、应用程序编程接口迁移和安全修复。从1130个符合条件的源变更开始，Change2Task在这些任务系列中实现了79.6%的验证任务构建成功率。在匹配的候选集中，它比基于pull请求的构建基线多恢复了29.2%的验证任务。在代理评估中，历史和重建案例实现了高达98.0%的匹配结果一致性，而现代基础的复用将整个流程的测量支出降低了10.8%。

articles.title: VAD: Attributing Visual Evidence for Target Reconstruction in Multimodal On-Policy Distillation
articles.abstract: Multimodal on-policy distillation (OPD) transfers fine-grained visual knowledge by supervising student-generated trajectories with a privileged-view teacher. Yet its next-token corrections are source-mixed, combining visual signals with linguistic priors and teacher-specific effects. The key challenge is to estimate which corrections are supported by visual evidence, not merely where or how strongly to distill. We introduce Visual Attribution Distillation (VAD), a counterfactual target-reconstruction algorithm that estimates the visually attributable part of a teacher correction. At each student-generated prefix, VAD evaluates the same fixed teacher with the relevant evidence present and removed. The corresponding change in centered log-probabilities defines ut, a signed proxy for the visual evidence direction that estimates how revealing the evidence supports or refutes candidate tokens. VAD projects the original correction onto this proxy to obtain an intervention-aligned component and a proxy-unexplained residual, then reconstructs a student-anchored target from the former. During training, this reconstructed target supplies the primary supervision signal, while the privileged teacher contributes a weak regularizer. Across six fine-grained visual benchmarks at 4B and 9B scales, VAD outperforms direct privileged-view distillation and visual-advantage weighting. Token- level and controlled-target analyses show that the proxy-aligned component is enriched in task-relevant visual corrections and yields stronger target shifts, especially when evidence refutes a mistaken answer. These results support counterfactual target reconstruction as an effective alternative to source-mixed supervision.
articles.titleCn: VAD：用于多模态在线策略蒸馏中目标重建的视觉证据归因
articles.abstractCn: 多模态策略内蒸馏（OPD）通过使用具有特权视图的教师监督学生生成的轨迹来转移细粒度视觉知识。然而，其下一个标记的校正混合了视觉信号、语言先验和教师特定效应。主要挑战在于估计哪些校正得到了视觉证据的支持，而不仅仅是蒸馏的位置或强度。我们引入了视觉归因蒸馏（VAD），这是一种反事实目标重建算法，用于估计教师校正中可归因于视觉的部分。在每个学生生成的前缀中，VAD使用相关证据存在和移除的情况下评估相同的固定教师。相应的中心对数概率变化定义了ut，这是一个有符号的代理，用于估计证据方向，以评估证据如何支持或反驳候选标记。VAD将原始校正投影到这个代理上，以获得干预对齐的分量和代理未解释的残差，然后从前者重建一个学生锚定的目标。在训练期间，这个重建的目标提供主要的监督信号，而特权教师贡献一个弱的正则化器。在4B和9B规模的六个细粒度视觉基准测试中，VAD优于直接特权视图蒸馏和视觉优势加权。标记级和受控目标分析表明，代理对齐的分量富含与任务相关的视觉校正，并产生更强的目标偏移，尤其是在证据反驳错误答案时。这些结果支持反事实目标重建作为混合来源监督的有效替代方案。

articles.title: Sample More, Reflect Less: Self-Refine and Reflexion Lose to Repeated Sampling at Equal Token Cost, from 1.5B to 7B
articles.abstract: Methods that make a language model plan, criticise and rewrite its own answer, reflect on mistakes, pick the best of several attempts, or debate with copies of itself nearly all make it generate far more text than a single chain of thought. Because generating more text raises accuracy by itself, a gain over one chain of thought does not show the method's idea is what helped. Wang et al. (2024) reported that a simple baseline, sampling the same question repeatedly and keeping the most common answer, often wins once budgets are comparable, but gave point estimates with no confidence intervals or significance tests. We rerun that comparison as a designed experiment: seven methods, open models of 1.5B, 3B and 7B parameters, two mathematics benchmarks, 150 questions each. We count every generated token, including those spent on critiques, reflections, debate turns and checking, and compare each method against repeated sampling at its own measured cost. All 36 comparisons are paired by question, with bootstrap intervals and multiplicity correction. No method is reliably better than repeated sampling at equal cost anywhere. Ten are reliably worse, all of them methods where the model inspects its own output, and all 18 self-inspection comparisons are negative. The two kinds of self-inspection part company as models grow. Choosing stops hurting: taking Best-of-N's eight samples and just counting the most common answer beats letting the model pick by 8.0 and 11.3 points at 1.5B, but only 2.0 and 1.3 at 7B, no longer distinguishable from zero. Rewriting does not recover: Self-Refine and a forced Reflexion stay 3.6 to 10.1 points below baseline at 7B. Reflexion as published never triggered its own retry on the smallest model. It judged itself correct every time and silently became a single chain of thought. We release code, prompts, all generations, and our verification scripts.
articles.titleCn: 样本更多，反思更少：自我精炼和反思在相同token成本下输给重复采样，从1.5B到7B
articles.abstractCn: 那些让语言模型规划、批评并重写自己的答案、反思错误、从多次尝试中挑选最佳方案，或与自己副本辩论的方法，几乎都使其生成的文本量远超单一思维链。由于生成更多文本本身就能提高准确性，因此超过单一思维链的收益并不能证明是该方法的思想带来了帮助。Wang等人（2024年）报告称，一个简单的基线方法——重复采样同一问题并保留最常见的答案——在预算可比时往往获胜，但仅提供了点估计，没有置信区间或显著性检验。我们重新运行了该比较，作为一项设计实验：七种方法、参数量分别为1.5B、3B和7B的开源模型、两个数学基准测试，每个150个问题。我们统计了每个生成的标记，包括用于批评、反思、辩论回合和检查的标记，并将每种方法与其自身测量的成本下的重复采样进行比较。所有36次比较均按问题配对，使用引导区间和多重性校正。没有方法在任何成本相同时可靠地优于重复采样。有10种方法可靠地更差，它们都是模型检查自身输出的方法，且所有18次自我检查比较均为负值。随着模型规模的增长，这两种自我检查方法开始分化。选择不再有害：取Best-of-N的8个样本并仅计算最常见的答案，在1.5B参数量下以8.0和11.3分的优势击败让模型选择，但在7B参数量下仅为2.0和1.3分，不再能与其他方法区分。重写无法恢复：Self-Refine和强制Reflexion在7B参数量下始终比基线低3.6至10.1分。发表的Reflexion在最小模型上从未触发自我重试。它每次都判断自己正确，并默默成为单一思维链。我们发布了代码、提示、所有生成文本以及我们的验证脚本。

articles.title: Frontis-MA1: Training an AI4AI Model towards Recursive Self-Improvement in Machine Learning Engineering

authors.name: Kaikai Zhao
authors.affiliation: benchmark-independent experience priors and asynchronous search

articles.abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) requires AI systems that improve the process of building AI (i.e., AI4AI); machine learning engineering (MLE) offers a concrete, executable testbed for studying this capability. We introduce OpenMLE, an open full-stack system for RSI research in MLE, spanning verifiable task environments with execution feedback (OpenMLE-Gym), operator learning (OpenMLE-RL), and long-horizon search (OpenMLE-Evo). On this stack we post-train Frontis-MA1 (35B) as a meta-evolution agent for MLE, aligning post-training and inference around four atomic program-evolution operators (Draft, Improve, Debug, Crossover): the same operators are trained via execution-grounded SFT and RL on data deduplicated against all evaluation benchmarks, then composed into long-horizon search, coupling learning and evolution in a single loop. On MLE-Bench Lite under a 12-hour per-task budget on one RTX 4090 capped at 12 GB VRAM, Frontis-MA1 (35B) improves Medal Average from 39.39% to 60.61% over its base model with OpenMLE-Evo, and reaches 71.21% with OpenMLE-Evo-Max (benchmark-independent experience priors and asynchronous search), exceeding GPT-5.5 + Codex and approaching GPT-5.6 Sol and the 2.8T Kimi K3. On held-out NatureBench Lite, both components transfer: with the framework fixed, swapping in the trained model raises Match-SOTA from 50% to 70%; with the model fixed, swapping in OpenMLE-Evo raises it from 20% to 50%. We release the model weights and the full OpenMLE stack to enable reproducible research on executable AI4AI toward RSI. Code: https://github.com/FrontisAI/OpenRSI
articles.titleCn: Frontis-MA1：训练一个面向机器学习工程递归自我改进的AI4AI模型
articles.abstractCn: 递归自我改进（RSI）需要能够改进构建AI过程（即AI4AI）的AI系统；机器学习工程（MLE）为研究这种能力提供了一个具体可执行的测试平台。我们介绍了OpenMLE，一个用于MLE中RSI研究的开放式全栈系统，涵盖可验证任务环境与执行反馈（OpenMLE-Gym）、算子学习（OpenMLE-RL）以及长时程搜索（OpenMLE-Evo）。在这个栈上，我们以Meta进化智能体（35B）的身份对Frontis-MA1进行后训练，围绕四个原子程序进化算子（草拟、改进、调试、交叉）对后训练和推理进行对齐：这些算子通过基于执行的监督微调和强化学习在所有评估基准的数据上进行训练，然后组合成长时程搜索，将学习和进化耦合在单一循环中。在单个12GB VRAM的RTX 4090上，每项任务预算为12小时，Frontis-MA1（35B）通过OpenMLE-Evo将其基础模型的Medal平均分从39.39%提升至60.61%，而OpenMLE-Evo-Max（基准无关的经验先验和异步搜索）则达到71.21%，超过GPT-5.5 + Codex，接近GPT-5.6 Sol和2.8T Kimi K3。在保留的NatureBench Lite上，两个组件均可迁移：在框架固定的情况下，替换训练好的模型将Match-SOTA从50%提升至70%；在模型固定的情况下，替换OpenMLE-Evo将其从20%提升至50%。我们发布了模型权重和完整的OpenMLE栈，以支持可复现的执行AI4AI研究向RSI发展。代码：https://github.com/FrontisAI/OpenRSI

articles.title: ORCA-bench: How Ready Are Language Model Agents for Oncall?

authors.name: Kyuseong Choi
authors.affiliation: Prometheus, Jaeger, and OpenSearch via Grafana

articles.abstract: Large language models can write, patch, and search code, but oncall root cause analysis (RCA) demands something different: reasoning over noisy metrics, logs, traces, and source code, starting from ambiguous user-facing reports, often hours after the incident began. We introduce ORCA-bench, a benchmark that puts general-purpose coding agents in a production-fidelity oncall setting. ORCA-bench pairs a live OpenTelemetry-instrumented microservice system--exposing six days of metrics, logs, and traces through real telemetry interfaces (Prometheus, Jaeger, and OpenSearch via Grafana) and full source-code access--with 1,079 RCA tasks that systematically vary report specificity, time-to-detection, and co-occurring fault scenarios. Ground-truth symptoms are curated and signed off by expert SREs, and our LLM-as-judge is independently re-scored by humans (Cohen's $κ_w=0.90$). Across five frontier agents, the best RCA Accuracy is 25.3% on Medium-difficulty tasks (the realistic-input setting) and 10.0% on Hard--a gap that remains even with Claude Fable 5. The weakest model hallucinates an implausible root cause in 40% of incident reports, and removing source-code access degrades every metric. Crucially, these are performances on a curated 50 GB / six-day testbed with tasks investigated in isolation on a system whose code and instrumentation are public. Since real production systems are order of magnitudes larger, more dynamic, and more idiosyncratic, the gap we report is a lower bound on the engineering investment required before frontier coding agents can be safely entrusted with production reliability. We release the public set at https://hub.harborframework.com/datasets/orca-bench/ORCA-bench.
articles.titleCn: ORCA-bench：语言模型代理准备好接听电话了吗？
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型能够编写、修复和搜索代码，但故障响应根因分析（RCA）则要求不同的能力：基于模糊的用户报告，对噪声指标、日志、追踪和源代码进行推理，通常在事件发生数小时后开始。我们介绍了ORCA-bench，这是一个将通用编程代理置于生产级故障响应环境中的基准测试。ORCA-bench将一个实时、使用OpenTelemetry进行监控的微服务系统（通过Prometheus、Jaeger和Grafana提供的OpenSearch接口暴露了六天的指标、日志和追踪，并提供完整源代码访问权限）与1,079个RCA任务相匹配，这些任务系统地变化报告的明确性、检测时间和并发故障场景。真实症状由专家SRE进行筛选和确认，我们的LLM作为评判者由人类独立重新评分（Cohen's $κ_w=0.90$）。在五个前沿代理中，最佳RCA准确率在中等难度任务（现实输入设置）上为25.3%，在困难任务上为10.0%——即使使用Claude Fable 5，差距依然存在。最弱的模型在40%的事件报告中产生不合理的根因，移除源代码访问会降低所有指标。关键在于，这些是在一个经过筛选的50 GB/六天测试平台上进行的，任务在代码和监控公开的系统上独立调查。由于真实生产系统更大、更动态、更特殊，我们报告的差距是前沿编程代理在安全承担生产可靠性之前所需的工程投入的下限。我们已将公共数据集发布在https://hub.harborframework.com/datasets/orca-bench/ORCA-bench。

articles.title: AI systems and the reproduction of (standard) language ideologies in World Englishes
articles.abstract: The rapid growth of large language models (LLMs) has resurrected age-old questions in sociolinguistics and world Englishes, such as who decides what counts as legitimate English, whose English is suspect etc. This paper examines how AI systems, their uses and discourse on them reflect, reinforce, and occasionally challenge (standard) language ideologies, which privilege Inner Circle norms and marginalize non-dominant Englishes. Drawing on evidence from empirical studies, media commentary, social media debates, and examples from AI outputs, the paper shows that AI technologies reproduce dominant language ideologies at different levels: training data, design protocols, evaluation benchmarks, user feedback and public commentary. The analysis uses the public controversy over AI-sounding language, especially the fixation on the word delve, to illustrate how speakers of English from the Global North police the English language norms of Global South English users. The paper also identifies what Christian Mair has called a "standardisation paradox": AI may homogenize English by privileging standard forms and at the same time pluralize Englishes through exposure to wide-ranging corpora and annotation work carried out by Global South users. In doing so, the paper argues that generative AI is reigniting long-standing debates in World Englishes about standardization, legitimacy, and the ownership of English, now playing out in algorithmic systems, model training, evaluation practices, and public discourse, where non-dominant Englishes are increasingly conflated with AI-generated speech. Discussing AI systems as a site where language ideologies are (re)produced, the paper argues for more inclusive design approaches that recognize the plurality of Englishes in order to address the real-world negative consequences of treating some as more legitimate than others.
articles.titleCn: 人工智能系统与世界英语中的（标准）语言意识形态的再生产
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的快速发展使社会语言学和世界英语研究中的古老问题重获新生，例如谁决定什么是合法英语，谁的英语可疑等。本文探讨了人工智能系统、其应用及其相关讨论如何反映、强化，有时甚至挑战（标准）语言意识形态，这些意识形态偏袒内圈规范并边缘化非主导英语。基于实证研究、媒体报道、社交媒体辩论以及人工智能输出实例的证据，本文表明人工智能技术在不同层面复制了主导语言意识形态：训练数据、设计协议、评估基准、用户反馈和公众评论。分析以公众对人工智能语言风格的争议，特别是对“delve”一词的执着为例，阐释了来自全球北方的英语使用者如何监管全球南方英语使用者的英语规范。本文还识别了克里斯蒂安·迈尔（Christian Mair）所谓的“标准化悖论”：人工智能可能通过偏袒标准形式使英语同质化，同时通过接触广泛语料库和全球南方使用者进行的标注工作使英语多元化。在此过程中，本文认为生成式人工智能正在重燃世界英语研究中长期存在的关于标准化、合法性和英语所有权之争，这些争论现在在算法系统、模型训练、评估实践和公众讨论中展开，而非主导英语正日益与人工智能生成的语言相混淆。本文将人工智能系统视为语言意识形态（再）生产的场所，主张采取更具包容性的设计方法，以承认英语的多样性，从而解决将某些英语视为比其他英语更合法所带来的现实负面影响。

articles.title: Creative Transformation in Literary Texts: Modelling Change Across Representational Levels
articles.abstract: Creativity is often framed as the production of novelty, yet many cultural works emerge through transformation of earlier artifacts and not through isolated invention. Drawing on theories of imitation by Gabriel Tarde and James Mark Baldwin, this paper models creativity as selective transformation across multiple levels of textual representation. We introduce a multi-level framework that compares literary texts across lexical, semantic, conceptual, structural, and narrative dimensions using directional alignment and control calibrated similarity measures. Applying the model to historically documented literary relationships, we show that different pairs preserve source structure at different representational levels while diverging in others. These transformation profiles provide a quantitative method for characterizing how imitation persists and where creative divergence occurs within literary works.
articles.titleCn: 文学文本中的创造性转化：跨表征层面的变化建模
articles.abstractCn: 创造力通常被定义为新颖性的产生，然而许多文化作品是通过转化早期文物而非孤立发明而出现的。本文借鉴加布里埃尔·塔尔德和詹姆斯·马克·鲍德温的模仿理论，将创造力建模为跨多级文本表征的选择性转化。我们引入一个多级框架，通过方向性对齐和校准相似度度量，在词汇、语义、概念、结构和叙事维度上比较文学文本。将模型应用于历史文献记录的文学关系，我们发现不同文本对在代表不同层级上保留源结构，同时在其他层级上出现分歧。这些转化特征为描述模仿如何在文学作品中持续存在以及创造性分歧发生的位置提供了一种定量方法。

articles.title: Generative AI and linguistic diversity in academic writing and publishing: Perspectives from World Englishes
articles.abstract: The rise of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) in academic writing and publishing (AWP) raises questions about linguistic inclusivity and the legitimacy of diverse Englishes in global scholarly communication. This article responds to these questions through a structured scholarly dialogue involving five sociolinguists from World Englishes and adjacent fields. Organised around five guiding questions, the dialogue interrogates how GenAI tools influence writing practices, reinforce or disrupt dominant language norms, and raise ethical challenges. Contributors reflect on the potential of GenAI to democratise writing processes while also raising concerns about GenAI's tendency to marginalise minoritised varieties and flatten nuance in scholarly writing. Across the dialogue, themes of linguistic (in)justice, researcher agency, and institutional responsibility emerge, with contributors calling for equity-informed policies, critical AI literacy, and inclusive co-design in GenAI development. The article shows the value of dialogic reflection in understanding GenAI's role in AWP. It concludes that while GenAI may reinforce existing hierarchies, it can also serve as a site of resistance, depending on how it is designed, governed and used within scholarly communities committed to linguistic diversity.
articles.titleCn: 生成式人工智能与学术写作及出版中的语言多样性：世界英语的视角
articles.abstractCn: 生成式人工智能（GenAI）在学术写作与出版（AWP）领域的兴起，引发了关于语言包容性以及多元英语在全球学术交流中合法性的问题。本文通过一场结构化的学术对话回应这些问题，对话由五位来自世界英语研究及相关领域的语言社会学家参与。围绕五个核心问题展开的对话，探讨了GenAI工具如何影响写作实践、强化或颠覆主流语言规范，以及其引发的伦理挑战。参与者反思了GenAI在使写作过程民主化的潜力，同时也表达了对GenAI倾向于边缘化少数语言变体以及削弱学术写作中细微差别的担忧。在整个对话中，语言（不）公正、研究者能动性以及机构责任等主题浮现，参与者呼吁制定以公平为导向的政策、提升批判性AI素养，并在GenAI开发中进行包容性共同设计。本文展示了对话式反思在理解GenAI在AWP中作用的价值。文章结论指出，虽然GenAI可能强化现有等级体系，但它也可以成为抵抗的场域，这取决于其在致力于语言多样性的学术社群中的设计、治理和使用方式。

articles.title: TCA-SIR: Learning Target-Conditioned Abstractions for Scientific Inspiration Retrieval
articles.abstract: Scientific hypothesis generation for AI for Science typically involves Scientific Inspiration Retrieval (SIR) followed by hypothesis composition. Existing SIR methods rank papers by topical similarity and do not explicitly represent how a candidate inspiration transfers to a target problem. This is especially limiting for remote inspirations, whose value often lies in reusable problem-solving principles rather than topical overlap. Motivated by how humans abstract transferable aspects of a source and remap them to a new target, we reformulate SIR as target-conditioned abstraction (TCA). The retrieval object is a transferable abstract principle extracted from a candidate specifically for the target. We present TCA-SIR, which learns to generate target-conditioned abstractions and uses their representations to predict transferability. On ResearchBench, TCA-SIR outperforms prior SIR methods and direct LLM retrieval, improving HitRate@top4% over MOOSE-Chem by more than 10 percentage points. Learned abstractions also recover target-relevant mechanisms more clearly than an untrained TCA prompt, yielding both stronger retrieval and an interpretable rationale for scientific inspiration.
articles.titleCn: TCA-SIR：为科学灵感检索学习目标条件抽象
articles.abstractCn: 针对科学领域的AI，科学假设生成通常涉及科学灵感检索（SIR）和假设组合。现有的SIR方法通过主题相似性对论文进行排序，并未明确表示候选灵感如何迁移到目标问题。这对远程灵感尤其有限，因为远程灵感的价值往往在于可复用的解决问题原则，而非主题重叠。受人类如何抽象源知识的可迁移方面并将其重新映射到新目标的方式启发，我们将SIR重新定义为目标条件抽象（TCA）。检索对象是从候选知识中提取的、专门针对目标的可迁移抽象原则。我们提出了TCA-SIR，该方法学习生成目标条件抽象，并利用其表示来预测可迁移性。在ResearchBench上，TCA-SIR优于先前的SIR方法及直接的大语言模型检索，其HitRate@top4%比MOOSE-Chem提高了超过10个百分点。学习到的抽象也比未训练的TCA提示更清晰地恢复目标相关机制，从而实现了更强的检索效果，并为科学灵感提供了可解释的推理依据。

articles.title: Beyond Sentiment: Structured Information Extraction from Financial News

authors.name: Yubo Hou
authors.affiliation: event type, impact subject, time horizon, confidence

articles.abstract: Financial sentiment analysis has become a standard component in news-driven stock prediction, yet it reduces rich, multi-dimensional news articles to a single polarity score. We hypothesize that financial news encodes multiple orthogonal information dimensions---event type, impact scope, temporal horizon, and semantic confidence---that sentiment alone cannot capture, and that these dimensions carry independent predictive value. To test this hypothesis, we propose a structured information extraction framework that leverages LLaMA-3.1-70B to extract six semantic dimensions from financial news. Through large-scale experiments on 41,618 news--stock pairs from the FNSPID dataset, we find that (i) FinBERT sentiment features exhibit strong predictive power under nonlinear models (F1=0.576) but substantially weaker performance under linear models (F1=0.230), revealing a highly nonlinear sentiment--return relationship; (ii) LLM-extracted structured features, while individually weaker, capture information orthogonal to sentiment, as evidenced by a 53.5% systematic disagreement rate between the two approaches; and (iii) combining both signal sources yields F1=0.600, significantly outperforming either alone ($p < 0.0001$), with consistent improvements across all seven event types. Ablation experiments confirm that non-sentiment structural dimensions (event type, impact subject, time horizon, confidence) independently contribute $Δ\text{F1} = +0.019$ beyond FinBERT alone. Feature importance analysis reveals balanced contributions from all six extracted dimensions (14--21%), demonstrating that compressing news into a single sentiment score incurs substantial information loss. Our results suggest that the sentiment--semantics decoupling in financial text is systematic and exploitable, opening a new direction for multi-dimensional financial NLP.
articles.titleCn: 超越情感：金融新闻中的结构化信息抽取
articles.abstractCn: 金融情绪分析已成为新闻驱动型股票预测的标准组成部分，但它将丰富、多维度的新闻文章简化为单一极性得分。我们假设金融新闻编码了多个正交信息维度——事件类型、影响范围、时间范围和语义置信度——这些维度无法被情绪单独捕捉，并且这些维度具有独立的预测价值。为验证这一假设，我们提出了一种结构化信息提取框架，利用LLaMA-3.1-70B从金融新闻中提取六个语义维度。通过对FNSPID数据集中41,618条新闻-股票对进行大规模实验，我们发现：(i) FinBERT情绪特征在非线性模型下表现出强大的预测能力（F1=0.576），但在线性模型下性能大幅减弱（F1=0.230），揭示了高度非线性的情绪-回报关系；(ii) 大语言模型提取的结构化特征虽然单独较弱，但捕捉了与情绪正交的信息，这一点通过两种方法之间存在53.5%的系统差异率得到证实；(iii) 结合两种信号源后F1=0.600，显著优于单独使用任何一种方法（p < 0.0001），并在所有七种事件类型中均保持一致的提升。消融实验证实，非情绪结构维度（事件类型、影响主体、时间范围、置信度）在FinBERT的基础上独立贡献了ΔF1 = +0.019。特征重要性分析显示，所有六个提取维度均做出了均衡贡献（14--21%），表明将新闻压缩为单一情绪得分会导致大量信息损失。我们的结果表明，金融文本中的情绪-语义解耦具有系统性和可利用性，为多维金融NLP开辟了新方向。

articles.title: Stage-Replay Divergence Follows the KV Cache: Fixed-Prefix Precision Controls and Bidirectional Cache Transplantation
articles.abstract: Stage-replay diagnostics reconstruct intermediate token prefixes and treat fresh-prefill continuation as continuation from the decoder state that originally reached the prefix. We audit that assumption at a whole reasoning-stage boundary in a Qwen2.5-derived system. A matched 200-item experiment compares retained live cache with one-shot prefill of identical integer tokens and places an exact replica on both sides. In BF16, replicas remain exact while the constructions differ on 166 suffixes and 20 correctness labels; the accuracy difference is only one point (paired 95% CI [-3.5, +5.5]). A fixed-prefix 2x2 holds all 200 token states constant while crossing construction and precision. The BF16 disagreements recur, whereas FP32 produces no decoded disagreement (95% Wilson upper bound 1.88%). A prospective bridge makes token-by-token incremental and retained live caches bit-exact on 12/12 rows; an all-200 saved-ledger audit reproduces every retained trajectory and comparison fingerprint. Bidirectional transplantation of all 48 key/value layers makes every tested divergent continuation follow its cache donor, both on a selected set at the primary checkpoint (24/24) and an outcome-blind replication at a later checkpoint (43/43). Exact-token replay can therefore be repeatable without preserving live-state fidelity. On the tested states, boundary K/V cache is a causally sufficient carrier of the divergent trajectory, while numerical precision moderates its behavioral expression.

articles.titleCn: 舞台重播发散遵循KV缓存：固定前缀精度控制和双向缓存移植
articles.abstractCn: 阶段回放诊断通过重建中间标记前缀，将新鲜预填充的延续视为从最初达到前缀的解码器状态开始的延续。我们在一个基于Qwen2.5的系统中的整个推理阶段边界上审计了这一假设。一个匹配的200项实验比较了保留的活缓存与相同整数标记的单次预填充，并在双方放置了精确副本。在BF16中，副本保持精确，但在166个后缀和20个正确性标签上构造不同；准确度差异仅为1点（配对95%置信区间[-3.5, +5.5]）。固定前缀的2x2在跨越构造和精度时保持所有200个标记状态恒定。BF16中的不一致性重现，而FP32未产生解码不一致（95%威尔逊上限1.88%）。前瞻性桥梁使标记逐个增量并保留的活缓存在第12/12行上实现位精确；所有200个保存账本的审计可重现每个保留轨迹和比较指纹。双向移植所有48个键/值层使每个测试的分歧延续都遵循其缓存供体，无论是在主要检查点（24/24）选择的一组中，还是在结果盲复制的后期检查点（43/43）。因此，精确标记回放可以重复进行，而无需保留活状态的保真度。在测试的状态下，边界K/V缓存是分歧轨迹的因果充分载体，而数值精度调节其行为表达。

articles.title: Would You Walk to the Car Wash? Revealing the Salience Bias of Large Language Models in Commonsense Reasoning
articles.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) continue to advance in complex reasoning tasks, they have learned to heavily prioritize explicit conditions provided in the input. However, in everyday commonsense reasoning, this mechanism exposes a critical vulnerability which we term Salience Bias: models become easily hijacked by useless explicit distractors (e.g., numerical values), leading them to ignore the implicit physical or commonsense prerequisites of a task. A critical open question is whether this failure reflects a genuine gap in commonsense knowledge or merely its suppression under misleading task framing. To investigate this, we construct the SaliTrap Benchmark, a high-quality dataset across four trap dimensions. Evaluating 12 state-of-the-art LLMs, we find that all mainstream models suffer significantly from salience bias, with severity scaling with distractor density and detecting the trap often decoupled from actually avoiding it. Crucially, by re-eliciting the same models with the task framing stripped away, we show that this is overwhelmingly a failure of \textbf{knowledge suppression rather than knowledge absence}: a context-free knowledge probe alone recovers over 90\% of sycophantic-compliance failures, revealing that the requisite commonsense is intrinsically present but actively crowded out by salient distractors that lure the model into over-compliant, unnecessary computation. Building on this diagnosis, we further show that lightweight, inference-time prompting alone substantially closes the gap without any retraining. Our findings relocate the bottleneck of commonsense reasoning failures from model competence to elicitation, and we release SaliTrap as a testbed for this blind spot. The codes are available at https://github.com/Wuzheng02/SaliTrap.
articles.titleCn: 你会步行去汽车清洗店吗？揭示大型语言模型在常识推理中的显著性偏差
articles.abstractCn: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）在复杂推理任务中的持续进步，它们学会了高度优先考虑输入中提供的明确条件。然而，在日常常识推理中，这种机制暴露了一个关键漏洞，我们称之为显著性偏差：模型容易被无用的明确干扰项（例如，数值）劫持，导致它们忽略任务的隐含物理或常识先决条件。一个关键的开放性问题在于，这种失败是否反映了常识知识的真实差距，还是仅仅因为误导性的任务框架而压制了它。为了研究这一点，我们构建了SaliTrap基准，这是一个涵盖四个陷阱维度的优质数据集。评估了12个最先进的LLMs，我们发现所有主流模型都严重受到显著性偏差的影响，其严重程度随着干扰项密度增加，且检测陷阱往往与实际避免陷阱脱钩。关键在于，通过移除任务框架后重新激发相同模型，我们表明这主要是知识压制而非知识缺失的失败：一个无上下文的知识探测就能恢复超过90%的奉承性服从失败，揭示了所需的常识本质上存在，但被显著的干扰项主动挤出，这些干扰项诱使模型进行过度服从、不必要的计算。基于这一诊断，我们进一步表明，仅通过轻量级的推理时提示即可显著缩小差距，而无需任何再训练。我们的研究将常识推理失败的瓶颈从模型能力转移到了激发能力，并将SaliTrap作为测试这一盲点的平台发布。代码可在https://github.com/Wuzheng02/SaliTrap获取。

articles.title: Improving Mental Health Screening and Early Risk Detection in Spanish
articles.abstract: Early detection of mental health disorders is often limited by the lack of specialized resources in Spanish and the difficulty of analyzing long histories of social media posts. This paper addresses these challenges through three main contributions. First, we introduce three Spanish foundational models specifically adapted to the mental health domain through domain-specific pre-training. Second, we propose Incremental Context Expansion (ICE), an automatic relabeling methodology designed for early detection. ICE identifies the point at which cumulative messages provide enough evidence of a disorder, generating more informative training samples. Third, we provide a set of fine-tuned models using the samples generated with the ICE methodology for early risk detection tasks. Our results on three Spanish benchmarks show that combining these specialized models with ICE improves the state-of-the-art, reducing detection latency while maintaining high performance. All models are publicly available.
articles.titleCn: 提升西班牙的心理健康筛查和早期风险识别
articles.abstractCn: 心理健康障碍的早期检测往往受限于西班牙语专业资源的缺乏以及分析社交媒体长期历史记录的困难。本文通过三个主要贡献来解决这些挑战。首先，我们引入了三个专门针对心理健康领域进行领域特定预训练的西班牙语基础模型。其次，我们提出了增量上下文扩展（ICE），这是一种专为早期检测设计的自动重标记方法。ICE识别累积信息提供足够证据表明存在障碍的节点，从而生成更具信息量的训练样本。第三，我们使用ICE方法生成的样本提供了一套用于早期风险检测任务的微调模型。我们在三个西班牙语基准测试中的结果表明，将这些专业模型与ICE结合使用可以提高当前最佳水平，同时减少检测延迟并保持高性能。所有模型均已公开。

articles.title: SVR: Self-Verifying Refinement via Joint Verdict-Confidence Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Test-Time Compute
articles.abstract: Scaling test-time computation can improve language-model reasoning, but uniform budgets waste computation on easy inputs, while verifier-guided refinement relies on external feedback. We introduce Self-Verifying Refinement (SVR), an oracle-free multi-turn reinforcement learning framework that learns to use self-verification as a compute-control policy. At each turn, the model produces a solution together with a discrete correctness verdict and a confidence score; it retains the current answer only when the verdict is Correct and confidence exceeds a threshold, and otherwise continues refinement using its own self-verification. Ground-truth correctness is used only to construct training rewards and is never exposed to the policy through refinement prompts or required at inference. SVR is trained with GRPO on fixed-horizon trajectories using rewards that promote solution correctness, calibration-aware self-verification, and stop-ready correct states; adaptive stopping is activated only at inference. On seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks with Qwen3.5-2B, SVR achieves a macro-average accuracy of 0.563 with only 2.99 inference turns on average. In the evaluated complete-system comparison, it exceeds standard GRPO, strong multi-turn baselines, and a fixed-budget oracle-guided score-feedback reference while requiring substantially fewer turns than fixed ten-turn inference. These results demonstrate that learned self-verification can serve as an effective internal control signal for answer retention and adaptive test-time compute allocation.
articles.titleCn: SVR：通过联合裁决-置信度强化学习实现自适应测试时计算的自我验证细化
articles.abstractCn: 通过扩展测试时的计算能力可以提升语言模型的推理能力，但均匀预算会在简单输入上浪费计算资源，而验证器引导的精炼则依赖外部反馈。我们引入了自验证精炼（SVR），这是一个无需外部或acles的多轮强化学习框架，该框架学习如何将自验证用作计算控制策略。在每一轮中，模型会生成一个解决方案，并附带一个离散的正确性判断和一个置信度分数；只有当判断为正确且置信度超过阈值时，模型才会保留当前答案，否则会继续使用自身的自验证进行精炼。真实正确性仅用于构建训练奖励，并且永远不会通过精炼提示或要求在推理过程中暴露给策略。SVR使用GRPO在固定时间范围内的轨迹上进行训练，使用的奖励旨在促进解决方案的正确性、校准感知的自验证和准备停止的正确状态；仅在推理时激活自适应停止。在七个数学推理基准测试中，使用Qwen3.5-2B，SVR实现了0.563的宏平均准确率，平均只需2.99轮推理。在评估的完整系统比较中，它超过了标准GRPO、强大的多轮基线以及固定预算的或acles引导的评分反馈参考，同时所需的轮数远少于固定十轮推理。这些结果表明，学习到的自验证可以作为答案保留和自适应测试时计算分配的有效内部控制信号。

articles.title: Lightning OPD 2.0: Mitigating Style Bias in Cross-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Large Reasoning Models
articles.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense token-level supervision from a teacher, but its effectiveness can depend on teacher consistency, meaning that the model providing OPD supervision should also have generated the demonstrations used to train the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) reference. However, this condition is frequently violated in practice when SFT data have mixed or unknown provenance or when different models are preferred for SFT data generation and subsequent distillation. In such cross-teacher settings, even a stronger OPD teacher can yield little improvement over the SFT reference. We find that raw teacher--reference disagreement contains potentially useful context-specific teacher evidence as well as a recurring component associated with differences in wording, formatting, and reasoning cadence. We introduce Lightning OPD 2.0 with cross-fitted style residualization, which uses rollout-level cross-fitting to estimate this recurring component as an operational proxy for style-token bias and subtracts it before constructing the token-level OPD update. Across mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks, Lightning OPD 2.0 consistently outperforms Lightning OPD in cross-teacher settings. Starting from Klear-Reasoner-8B-SFT, Lightning OPD 2.0 reaches 82.4% on AIME 2024 and 63.0% on LiveCodeBench v5. Together, these results establish Lightning OPD 2.0 as a practical approach to cross-teacher OPD, relaxing teacher consistency as a prerequisite and allowing the SFT data generator and distillation teacher to be selected independently. Code will be released soon.
articles.titleCn: 闪电OPD 2.0：缓解跨教师在线策略蒸馏中大型推理模型的风格偏差
articles.abstractCn: 策略内蒸馏（OPD）能从教师模型提供密集的标记级监督，但其有效性可能依赖于教师的一致性，这意味着提供OPD监督的模型也应当生成用于训练监督微调（SFT）参考的演示。然而，在实际应用中，当SFT数据来源混合或未知，或SFT数据生成与后续蒸馏使用不同模型时，这一条件常被违反。在跨教师设置中，即使更强的OPD教师也可能对SFT参考提升有限。我们发现，原始教师与参考之间的不一致性包含了潜在的、特定上下文的教师证据，以及与措辞、格式和推理节奏差异相关的循环成分。我们引入了带有跨拟合风格残差化的Lightning OPD 2.0，该技术通过跨拟合在策略级估计这一循环成分，作为风格标记偏差的操作代理，并在构建标记级OPD更新前将其减去。在数学推理和代码生成基准测试中，Lightning OPD 2.0在跨教师设置中始终优于Lightning OPD。从Klear-Reasoner-8B-SFT开始，Lightning OPD 2.0在AIME 2024上达到82.4%，在LiveCodeBench v5上达到63.0%。这些结果共同确立了Lightning OPD 2.0作为一种实用的跨教师OPD方法，放宽了教师一致性的前提条件，并允许独立选择SFT数据生成器和蒸馏教师。代码即将发布。

articles.title: Beyond a Single Judge: The Evidence-Grounded, Social-Weighted Persona Panel for Generative UI Evaluation
articles.abstract: Generative UI (GenUI) lets large language models synthesize a complete, renderable interface directly from a natural-language instruction, but evaluating the quality of what they generate remains an open problem. Human evaluation is costly and rater-variant, while LLM-as-a-judge is scalable but reflects only a single implicit viewpoint, unable to capture how different populations of real users actually perceive the same interface. We propose the Evidence-Grounded, Social-Weighted Persona Panel (ESPP), a three-stage GenUI evaluation method in which a panel of psychologically diverse, evidence-grounded personas independently rates a screenshot, exchanges opinions under a trait-derived, semantically-gated bounded-confidence mechanism, and is aggregated via Delphi-inspired social weighting into a single judgment. ESPP tracks human judgment substantially more closely than a naive single-pass judge, raising Pearson $r$ from $0.716$ to $0.922$, and a prompt-ensemble control recovers only about a third of this gap, isolating genuine persona and evidence grounding as the dominant source of improvement. Beyond this fidelity gain, retaining each panelist's individual rating further reveals that user subgroups agree on overall model rankings yet diverge sharply on specific rating dimensions, a structural disagreement a single homogeneous judge would systematically erase. The codes are available at https://github.com/Wuzheng02/ESPP.
articles.titleCn: 超越单一法官：基于证据、社会权重的人格小组用于生成式界面评估
articles.abstractCn: 生成式界面（GenUI）能够让大型语言模型直接根据自然语言指令合成一个完整且可渲染的界面，但评估其生成质量仍然是一个开放的问题。人工评估成本高昂且存在评分者差异，而将LLM作为评判者虽然具有可扩展性，但仅反映单一隐含视角，无法捕捉真实用户群体对同一界面的实际感知。我们提出了基于证据、社交加权的角色小组（ESPP），这是一种三阶段GenUI评估方法：由心理多样性且基于证据的角色小组独立对截图进行评分，在基于特征推导、语义门控的置信度限制机制下交换意见，并通过德尔菲式社交加权聚合为单一判断。与简单的单次评判相比，ESPP能更紧密地追踪人类判断，将皮尔逊相关系数从0.716提升至0.922，而提示集成控制组仅恢复了约三分之一的差距，从而将真实角色和证据基础定位为改进的主要来源。除了这种保真度提升外，保留每位小组成员的独立评分进一步揭示，用户子群体在整体模型排名上达成共识，但在具体评分维度上存在显著分歧，这种结构性分歧是单一同质化评判者会系统性地抹除的。代码可在https://github.com/Wuzheng02/ESPP获取。

articles.title: Metaphor Tracer: A Theory-Informed Analysis of Hidden States
articles.abstract: What do a language model's hidden states say about the organization of a single text? From one forward pass, without training, we score every token position on two properties. The *aggregator* measures whether the position consolidates the whole text into a stable configuration. The *differentiator*, whether other tokens are transiently carried into its subspace as the model reads: metaphor in its root sense, transport. Constants were frozen on one discovery text; every other is confirmatory. The aggregator is not, in the classic sense, an information measure, nor a measure of salience. Across three unrelated models, as a signifier repeats, its surprisal and its attention drain while its aggregator score holds: the channel marks a token's place in the text. That this tracks a reading rests on independent ground truth: an engineered register the aggregator follows across its boundaries (6/6 cells), and a psychoanalyst's marking of clinical transcripts, fixed before the instrument existed, in 34/36 cells, with a graded increment above lexical controls and dissociations no type-level measure reproduces. A transfer test gives the result its shape: the model whose token structure travels with lexical type reads the singular discourse worst, and in a matched base/instruct pair tuning raises fidelity without moving type-transfer. Structural value is a property of a token's place in *this* text, not of its vector alone: a relational rather than essentialist reading of hidden states, operationalizing theory that predated the instrument.
articles.titleCn: 隐喻追踪器：基于理论分析隐藏状态
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型的隐藏状态如何揭示单个文本的组织结构？在未经训练的情况下，我们通过一次前向传递，对每个词元位置评估两个属性。*聚合器*衡量该位置是否将整个文本整合为一个稳定配置，而*区分器*则衡量模型读取时，其他词元是否暂时进入其子空间：其本义中的比喻意义，即传递。在一个发现文本上冻结了常数；其他文本则用于验证。从经典意义上讲，聚合器既不是信息度量，也不是显著性度量。在三个无关模型中，随着指称符号的重复，其意外度和注意力消耗下降，而聚合器得分保持不变：信道标记了词元在文本中的位置。这一结果与阅读过程相符，基于独立的真实标准：一个聚合器遵循其边界（6/6个单元）的工程化语域，以及心理分析师在仪器出现前标记的临床记录（34/36个单元），在词汇控制和分离的分级增量上，没有类型级度量能重现。迁移测试赋予了结果其形态：词元结构随词汇类型迁移的模型，在阅读单数话语时表现最差，而在匹配的基座/指令对微调中，提高了保真度而不移动类型迁移。结构价值是词元在*这个*文本中的位置属性，而非其向量本身：是对隐藏状态的关联性而非本质主义解读，实现了先于仪器存在的理论。

articles.title: WIDE: Boosting Adaptive LLM Inference via Token-level Dynamic Width Pruning
articles.abstract: Pruning is a promising approach for improving the efficiency of LLMs. Existing static structured pruning methods are hardware-friendly and can deliver practical throughput gains, but their input-agnostic computation allocation often causes substantial accuracy degradation under aggressive sparsity. Recent dynamic sparsity methods improve quality retention by adapting computation to individual inputs, yet they remain largely limited to coarse-grained structural decisions and their practical acceleration under real-world inference scenarios remains challenging. To address these challenges, we present WIDE, the first end-to-end differentiable token-level dynamic width pruning framework designed for both prefill and decode scenarios. WIDE enables fine-grained computation allocation by allowing each token to dynamically select attention-head groups and FFN-channel groups, extending dynamic pruning beyond layer-level decisions to neuron-block-level granularity. Through a two-stage training pipeline, WIDE learns effective token-wise sparse execution patterns and achieves substantially better quality retention than existing approaches. To make such fine-grained dynamic pruning practical, we further propose a pruning--kernel co-design framework that decomposes dynamic sparsity acceleration into mask reordering, hardware-agnostic block-level skipping, and hardware-dependent intra-block skipping, enabling efficient execution across different granularities. At 50% sparsity, WIDE provides 55.1% performance boost when compared to the state-of-the-art dynamic depth pruning under calibration-only settings. Under prefill and decoding inference workloads, WIDE achieves close-to-theoretical kernel-level speedups of up to 1.98x for prefill and 4.95x for decoding, as well as 1.68x and 1.55x end-to-end acceleration. Our code is available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/LLM-Pruning/tree/main/WIDE.
articles.titleCn: WIDE：通过 token 级动态宽度剪枝提升自适应大型语言模型推理性能
articles.abstractCn: 剪枝是提升大型语言模型（LLM）效率的一种有前景的方法。现有的静态结构化剪枝方法对硬件友好，能够实现实际的吞吐量提升，但其输入无关的计算分配在强稀疏性下往往导致显著的精度下降。近期的动态稀疏性方法通过针对单个输入调整计算来提高质量保留，但它们仍然主要局限于粗粒度的结构化决策，且在实际推理场景下的实际加速效果仍具挑战性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了WIDE，首个面向预填充和解码场景的端到端可微分token级动态宽度剪枝框架。WIDE通过允许每个token动态选择注意力头组和前馈网络（FFN）通道组，实现了细粒度的计算分配，将动态剪枝从层级决策扩展到神经元块级粒度。通过两阶段训练流程，WIDE学习到有效的token级稀疏执行模式，并相较于现有方法实现了显著更好的质量保留。为使这种细粒度动态剪枝更具实用性，我们进一步提出了一种剪枝核协同设计框架，将动态稀疏性加速分解为掩码重排、硬件无关的块级跳过和硬件相关的块内跳过，从而实现跨不同粒度的有效执行。在50%稀疏度下，WIDE在仅校准设置下相较于当前最先进的动态深度剪枝性能提升了55.1%。在预填充和解码推理工作负载下，WIDE实现了高达1.98倍的预填充和4.95倍的解码的理论接近级内核级加速，以及1.68倍和1.55倍端到端加速。我们的代码可在https://github.com/EIT-NLP/LLM-Pruning/tree/main/WIDE获取。

articles.title: Demystifying Entropy-based Selection for Chain-of-Thought Compression in Large Reasoning Models
articles.abstract: Entropy-based pruning has been proposed as an effective method for compressing Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning with negligible accuracy loss. We test the robustness of low- and high-entropy CoT step selection methods across various models and reasoning tasks, showing that entropy offers no advantage over random pruning in any evaluated setting. Moving from sentences to tokens, we then show that retaining low-entropy tokens seems effective only on mathematical benchmarks. We find this is due to the inherently low-entropy nature of numeric tokens, which also convey semantic content in such problems. Finally, we demonstrate that patching a subset of a few CoT tokens with their original activations recovers near-perfect full-trace performance, providing causal evidence that task information is not concentrated in a small set of CoT tokens identifiable by heuristics, but rather distributed across the full reasoning chain.
articles.titleCn: 揭秘基于熵的选择在大型推理模型中的思维链压缩
articles.abstractCn: 基于熵的剪枝方法已被提出作为一种压缩思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）推理且精度损失可忽略的有效方法。我们测试了低熵和高熵CoT步骤选择方法在不同模型和推理任务中的鲁棒性，结果表明在所有评估场景中，熵均不优于随机剪枝。接着，我们从句子转向标记，发现仅保留低熵标记在数学基准测试中似乎有效。我们发现这是因为数字标记本身具有固有的低熵特性，并且在这些问题中还能传达语义信息。最后，我们证明通过用原始激活值修补一小部分CoT标记，可以恢复近乎完美的全路径性能，这提供了因果证据：任务信息并非集中在可通过启发式方法识别的一小部分CoT标记中，而是分布在整个推理链中。

articles.title: Can Large Language Models Execute Parent Orders?
articles.abstract: Parent-order execution is a core problem in algorithmic trading, where the goal is to split a large order into smaller orders while reducing execution costs. Existing approaches either rely on pre-specified market assumptions that may not hold in practice, or require task-specific training that limits adaptability to new settings. To overcome these limitations, we present the first systematic study of large language models (LLMs) for parent-order execution. This extends the use of LLMs in finance from what to trade to how to execute. We propose PACE (Plan-Ahead Controlled Execution), a hierarchical framework that decomposes parent-order execution into long-horizon planning and short-horizon execution, requiring neither explicit market assumptions nor task-specific training. Experiments on Shenzhen Stock Exchange Level-1 data show that PACE outperforms TWAP, Almgren-Chriss, and learning-based baselines, exceeding the strongest baseline by 0.65 bps. Behavioral analysis reveals that LLMs make execution decisions differently from human investors: higher model confidence predicts better performance rather than worse returns, and the model trades earlier rather than procrastinating toward the deadline. These findings suggest that LLMs can complement human traders in execution decisions.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型能执行家长命令吗？
articles.abstractCn: 父订单执行是算法交易中的一个核心问题，其目标是将大订单拆分为小订单，同时降低执行成本。现有方法要么依赖于可能在实践中不成立的预设市场假设，要么需要针对特定任务的训练，这限制了其对新环境的适应性。为了克服这些局限性，我们首次对大型语言模型（LLMs）在父订单执行中的应用进行了系统性研究。这项研究将LLMs在金融领域的应用从“交易什么”扩展到了“如何执行”。我们提出了PACE（提前规划控制执行）这一分层框架，将父订单执行分解为长期规划和短期执行，既不需要明确的市场假设，也不需要针对特定任务的训练。在深圳证券交易所Level-1数据上的实验表明，PACE优于TWAP、Almgren-Chriss以及基于学习的基线方法，其表现比最强的基线高出0.65个基点。行为分析揭示，LLMs在执行决策上与人类投资者有所不同：模型置信度越高，预测性能越好而非回报越差，并且模型更早进行交易而非拖延至截止日期。这些发现表明，LLMs可以在执行决策中补充人类交易员。

articles.title: GLM-RAG: Graph Language Models for Graph-Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation
articles.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over knowledge graphs requires retrievers that can effectively capture both graph structure and semantic information. Recent approaches have explored graph neural network (GNN)-based retrievers to model graph topology in multi-hop reasoning tasks. In parallel, graph language models (GLMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm that integrates graph reasoning and the semantic capabilities of language models. In this work, we introduce a GLM-based retriever and investigate the comparative strengths of GLM-based, GNN-based, and traditional vector-search-based retrievers in single- and multi-hop RAG settings, and with a particular focus on transferability to unseen domains. Our findings suggest that finetuned GLM retrievers generalize better out of domain, achieving SOTA on two multi-hop benchmarks. On in-domain multi-hop QA datasets they remain comparable to prior work, with promising scaling as parameters and subgraph coverage increase. GNN-based retrievers achieve higher graph coverage with an efficient training setup, whereas the vector-search baseline excels at single-hop datasets.
articles.titleCn: 基于图的检索增强生成用的图语言模型：GLM-RAG
articles.abstractCn: 知识图谱上的检索增强生成（RAG）需要能够有效捕捉图结构和语义信息的检索器。近期方法探索了基于图神经网络（GNN）的检索器，以在多跳推理任务中建模图拓扑。与此同时，图语言模型（GLM）作为一种集成图推理和语言模型语义能力的有前景范式应运而生。在这项工作中，我们引入了一种基于GLM的检索器，并研究了在单跳和多跳RAG设置下，基于GLM、基于GNN和传统向量搜索检索器的比较优势，特别关注其对未见领域的可迁移性。我们的研究表明，微调的GLM检索器在跨领域泛化方面表现更佳，在两个多跳基准测试中达到了SOTA。在领域内多跳问答数据集上，它们与先前工作相当，并且随着参数和子图覆盖率的增加，展现出可扩展的潜力。基于GNN的检索器在高效的训练设置下实现了更高的图覆盖率，而向量搜索基线在单跳数据集上表现优异。

articles.title: Correlation between prosody and pragmatics: A case study of the discourse marker hālā `now' in Persian

authors.name: Kevin Tang
authors.affiliation: topic shifting, signaling relationships, boundary marking, attention guidance, topic introduction, and topic emphasis

articles.abstract: The Persian discourse marker hālā ('now') exhibits remarkable multifunctionality, extending far beyond its temporal adverbial role to encompass a variety of pragmatic functions. This study presents a pragmatic and acoustic analysis of hālā in spoken Persian, examining 267 instances from spontaneous conversations. While temporal uses were present, they were often combined with other discourse marker functions, indicating extensive multifunctionality, with 70% of tokens serving two or more pragmatic roles. Textual functions (topic shifting, signaling relationships, boundary marking, attention guidance, topic introduction, and topic emphasis) were most frequent, followed by interactive functions (turn management, listener engagement, and feedback regulation), and modal functions (epistemic stance, emotional expression, and attitudinal marking). Prosodic analysis revealed that duration and intensity are key cues for distinguishing hālā's functions. Textual uses were significantly shorter, while temporal uses showed a tendency toward longer realizations. Interactive functions correlated with higher intensity, while modal functions showed a weaker tendency toward lower intensity. These findings indicate that duration and intensity are the main prosodic cues associated with functional differentiation in hālā, especially in textual and interactive uses.
articles.titleCn: 韵律与语用学之间的关联：以波斯语话语标记词hālā `现在'为例的个案研究
articles.abstractCn: 波斯语话语标记词hālā（意为"现在"）展现出显著的多功能性，其作用远超时间副词的范畴，涵盖了多种语用功能。本研究对口语波斯语中的hālā进行了语用和声学分析，考察了自发性对话中的267个实例。虽然存在时间用法，但它们常常与其他话语标记功能结合，表明其多功能性极强，其中70%的标记词承担了两种或以上的语用角色。文本功能（话题转换、关系标示、边界标记、注意力引导、话题引入和话题强调）最为常见，其次是互动功能（话轮管理、听众参与和反馈调节），最后是情态功能（认知立场、情感表达和态度标记）。声学分析显示，时长和强度是区分hālā功能的关键线索。文本用法显著较短，而时间用法则倾向于更长的实现形式。互动功能与更高的强度相关，而情态功能则表现出较弱的低强度趋势。这些结果表明，时长和强度是与hālā功能差异相关的最主要韵律线索，尤其是在文本和互动用法中。

articles.title: LLMs struggle to simulate human belief updates in controlled environments
articles.abstract: LLMs are increasingly deployed as proxies for human study participants in social science experiments, yet the fidelity of this practice has rarely been tested directly. We test whether six LLMs can simulate individual human belief updates, comparing LLM outputs 1-to-1 against ground truth data from 391 UK participants on Prolific, who updated their stances on three discussion topics after reading Reddit comments. Each participant was simulated by an LLM conditioned on a persona derived from their demographic and personality trait data. We find that some LLMs (Qwen3-32B and GPT-5-Mini) can match the human post-stance distribution, but only when given participants' actual initial stances. All six models fail to simulate initial stances themselves and to produce faithful belief updates from self-generated stances. Three systematic biases emerge across all models: overrepresentation of neutral positions, more frequent but smaller belief shifts than humans, and a failure to rank comments by convincingness. Demographic and personality trait personas had no consistent effect on fidelity. LLM simulations of human belief dynamics are only reliable when grounded in realistic starting conditions, that current multi-round social media simulations rarely provide.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型在受控环境中难以模拟人类信念更新
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地被用作社会科学实验中人类研究参与者的代理，然而这种做法的真实性却很少得到直接检验。我们测试了六个LLMs是否能够模拟个体人类的信念更新，将LLM的输出与来自Prolific平台上391名英国参与者的真实数据（这些参与者阅读了Reddit评论后，就三个讨论话题更新了他们的立场）进行一对一比较。每个参与者都由一个基于其人口统计和人格特质数据生成的角色信息的LLM进行模拟。我们发现，某些LLMs（Qwen3-32B和GPT-5-Mini）能够匹配人类的立场分布，但前提是它们被提供了参与者实际的初始立场。所有六个模型都无法模拟初始立场，也无法从自生成的立场中产生忠实的信念更新。所有模型都出现了三种系统性偏差：中立立场被过度代表、比人类更频繁但幅度更小的信念转变，以及无法按说服力对评论进行排序。人口统计和人格特质角色信息对真实性没有持续的影响。只有当基于现实起始条件时，LLMs模拟人类信念动态才是可靠的，而当前的多轮社交媒体模拟很少提供这样的条件。

articles.title: Fairness Pruning: Locating Demographic Bias in GLU-MLP Layers via Differential Activations
articles.abstract: This work presents Fairness Pruning, a lightweight structural intervention method designed for the management and future mitigation of demographic bias in large language models (LLMs). As a foundational empirical validation of this method, this work focuses on causal bias localization. Using minimally contrastive prompt pairs and inference-time activation capture, the method identifies neurons that react differentially when processing demographic attributes in GLU architectures, evaluating the signal at the down_proj input. Empirical evaluation was conducted on models of up to 3 billion parameters (Llama-3.2 family and Salamandra-2B), combining standardized benchmark evaluation with qualitative text generation experiments. Results demonstrate that zeroing the identified neurons alters how the model responds to associated demographic variables. However, rather than producing flat mitigation, the intervention causes bidirectional bias destabilization: because BiasScore is unsigned, candidate sets mix neurons that push toward and against the stereotype, and the net effect on aggregate bias depends on which sign dominates. The intervention is extremely surgical: zeroing at most 40 neurons in Llama-3.2-1B (less than 0.031% of total MLP width) achieves a mean retention of 99.49% in reasoning and general knowledge capabilities. These findings empirically confirm that demographic bias processing and model capabilities operate on dissociable circuits, establishing the methodological foundations for transitioning from blind zeroing toward directional behavior modulation.
articles.comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables. Code and datasets publicly available
articles.titleCn: 公平剪枝：通过差分激活定位GLU-MLP层中的群体偏差
articles.abstractCn: 这项工作提出了公平剪枝（Fairness Pruning），这是一种轻量级结构干预方法，旨在管理和未来缓解大型语言模型（LLMs）中的群体偏差。作为验证此方法的基础实证研究，这项工作专注于因果偏差定位。通过使用最小对比性提示对和在推理时捕获激活，该方法识别出在处理GLU架构中的群体属性时反应不同的神经元，并在down_proj输入处评估信号。实证评估在参数高达30亿（Llama-3.2系列和Salamandra-2B）的模型上展开，结合标准化基准评估和定性文本生成实验。结果表明，使识别出的神经元归零会改变模型对相关群体变量的响应方式。然而，这种干预并非产生平缓的缓解效果，而是导致双向偏差不稳定：由于BiasScore是无符号的，候选集混合了推动和反对刻板印象的神经元，净效应对总体偏差的影响取决于哪种符号占主导。这种干预极其精准：在Llama-3.2-1B中最多归零40个神经元（占总MLP宽度的0.031%以下），即可实现推理和一般知识能力的平均保留率99.49%。这些发现从实证上证实了群体偏差处理和模型能力在分离的电路中运作，为从盲目归零转向定向行为调制奠定了方法论基础。

articles.title: CACHE-UK: A Stability-Aware Memory Editor for Sequentially Updated Quantized LLMs in Finance
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) deployed in dynamic financial environments face a critical challenge: maintaining factual accuracy as market conditions, regulations, and corporate facts change continuously. While 4-bit quantization enables efficient deployment, it severely limits the viability of sequential memory editing: existing methods undergo catastrophic performance degradation under this "quantization stability crisis." We introduce CACHE-UK (Contextual Adaptive Continual Hybrid Editor for UK Finance), a stability-aware memory editing framework specifically designed for domain-specific, quantized LLMs. CACHE-UK integrates three components: a rank-1 LoRA perturbation mechanism that confines edits to the low-rank adapter subspace, a financial domain prioritization module for content-adaptive edit strength, and a closed-loop Stability Controller that tracks "degradation debt" to prevent catastrophic forgetting across sequential updates.
