Our analyses attribute these gains to organizing and exploring semantic evidence regions, which improves groundedness and diversity and yields more useful findings under the same subquestion budget. These results demonstrate the value of structured semantic exploration for systematic research and discovery over heterogeneous data lakes.
articles.titleCn: 贝加尔：针对数据湖深度研究的数据结构化搜索
articles.abstractCn: 对数据湖进行深度研究需要大型语言模型代理来调查数千个异构表格和段落中的证据，以综合报告。现有方法执行迭代检索和生成，让累积的上下文决定下一步调查什么，这可能导致过度利用局部有希望的证据，并且在固定预算下无法涵盖不同的语义区域。为解决这个问题，我们将数据湖的深度研究视为一个预算搜索问题，并提出了Baikal框架——该框架将异构证据聚类成语义区域，然后自适应地搜索这些区域以平衡探索和利用。在每个选定的区域内，Baikal生成并调查基于区域的子问题，使用发现质量作为奖励来更新区域级价值估计，并在从随机和LLM引导选择到贝叶斯$ε$-贪婪和UCB的政策范围内指导搜索。我们在包含10,993个表格的HybridQA和包含2,757个表格的TAT-QA数据湖上对Baikal进行了评估，这两个数据湖还包含227K个维基百科段落和13K个财务报告段落。我们使用涵盖基础性、相关性、多样性和实用性的一项新评分标准来评估研究质量，并使用GPT-5-mini对Baikal和强基线（包括DeepSearcher和一个具有检索和聚类变体的OpenCode研究代理）进行评分。在两个数据湖上，Baikal在几种区域选择政策下表现优异；其最佳配置在HybridQA上使报告评分比最强基线提高了28%，在TAT-QA上提高了36%。我们的分析将这些收益归因于组织和探索语义证据区域，这提高了基础性和多样性，并在相同的子问题预算下产生了更有用的发现。这些结果表明，结构化的语义探索对于在异构数据湖上进行系统研究和发现具有重要价值。

articles.title: Recall Before You Rank: Similarity-Guided Top-$K$ Reuse for Efficient Long-Context Attention
articles.abstract: Top-$K$ sparse attention reduces the cost of Softmax and value aggregation by attending to only a small subset of key--value (KV) entries. However, identifying this subset still requires scoring the current query against the full KV cache and performing global Top-$K$ selection, leaving selector cost linear in context length and limiting the practical efficiency of sparse attention for long-context decoding. In this paper, we introduce ReTopK, a training-free method that accelerates dynamic Top-$K$ attention by reusing historical retrieval decisions. ReTopK builds on the observation that similar queries often attend to overlapping supports and that partially overlapping supports can still preserve most of the Exact Top-$K$ attention mass. For each attention head, it maintains a bounded cache of historical query--support pairs, retrieves the most similar cached queries for each new query, unions their stored supports with a recent window, and reranks only the resulting compact candidate set using exact current-query scores. A similarity-based fallback invokes full-history Exact Top-$K$ when reuse is unreliable, while periodic exact refreshes limit cache drift. ReTopK retains the complete KV cache and reuses only selected indices, rather than historical scores, attention weights, or outputs. Across 16K--128K contexts, ReTopK achieves the lowest PG19 perplexity and the highest NIAH and LongBench scores among the evaluated approximate methods. At 128K with $K=512$, ReTopK incurs only a 0.50\% perplexity increase over Exact Top-$K$ while accelerating attention computation by $3.07\times$.
articles.titleCn: 在排序前回忆：基于相似性的高效长上下文注意力Top-K重用
articles.abstractCn: Top-K稀疏注意力通过仅关注一小部分键值（KV）条目来降低Softmax和值聚合的成本。然而，识别该子集仍然需要将当前查询与完整的KV缓存进行评分，并执行全局Top-K选择，导致选择器成本与上下文长度呈线性关系，限制了稀疏注意力在长上下文解码中的实际效率。在本文中，我们引入ReTopK，这是一种无需训练的方法，通过重用历史检索决策来加速动态Top-K注意力。ReTopK基于以下观察：相似的查询通常会关注重叠的支持，并且部分重叠的支持仍然可以保留大部分精确Top-K注意力的质量。对于每个注意力头，它维护一个有界的历史查询-支持对缓存，为每个新查询检索最相似的缓存查询，将它们存储的支持与最近窗口合并，并仅使用精确当前查询分数重新对生成的紧凑候选集进行排序。基于相似性的回退在重用不可靠时调用完整历史的精确Top-K，而周期性的精确刷新限制了缓存漂移。ReTopK保留完整的KV缓存，仅重用选定的索引，而不是历史分数、注意力权重或输出。在16K-128K上下文中，ReTopK在评估的近似方法中实现了最低的PG19困惑度和最高的NIAH和LongBench分数。在128K且K=512时，ReTopK在精确Top-K上仅增加了0.50%的困惑度，同时将注意力计算加速了3.07倍。

articles.title: Tight Sample Complexity for Low-Rank Adaptation: Matching Bounds and Rank Selection
articles.abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has become the standard mechanism for fine-tuning large pretrained models, yet its statistical properties remain only partially understood. Existing generalization results provide upper bounds of the form O~(sqrt(rd/n)) or O~(rd/n), but a matching lower bound is missing, and the question of how to choose the LoRA rank r has no formal answer. Both gaps are closed here. A local Rademacher argument establishes an upper bound of O~(rd/n) on the excess risk of the empirical risk minimizer over rank-r LoRA, whenever the target adaptation has rank at most r. A matching minimax lower bound of Omega(rd/n) is then proved via a Fano-type packing of the rank-r subspace of R^{d x d}; the bound applies to any estimator whose output lies in the rank-r LoRA class. Combining the two yields a rank-selection dichotomy. For the constrained empirical risk minimizer, the optimal rank equals the intrinsic rank r*, and over-ranking strictly hurts. For adaptive estimators of the nuclear-norm-then-truncate type, over-ranking is harmless and the rate saturates at Theta~(r* d / n) regardless of r. Taken together, the three results characterize the statistical complexity of LoRA fine-tuning within the well-specified locally quadratic regime, and identify the empirically observed over-parameterization penalty as a property of unregularized empirical risk minimization rather than of the LoRA class itself. Predictions of the theory are verified on a synthetic trace-regression benchmark and on real LoRA fine-tuning across three (model, task) configurations covering DistilBERT and RoBERTa on SST-2 and MRPC. All configurations exhibit the predicted U-shape in validation loss, with two showing statistically significant loss inflation at large ranks (paired permutation p = 0.016).
articles.titleCn: 低秩自适应的紧样本复杂度：匹配界限与秩选择
articles.abstractCn: 低秩适配（LoRA）已成为微调大型预训练模型的标准机制，但其统计特性仍仅部分被理解。现有泛化结果提供了形式为O~(sqrt(rd/n))或O~(rd/n)的上界，但缺少匹配的下界，且关于如何选择LoRA秩r的问题没有正式答案。本文填补了这两个空白。通过局部Rademacher不等式，在目标适配秩最多为r时，建立了经验风险最小化器相对于秩-r LoRA的过剩风险上界为O~(rd/n)。随后，通过在R^{d x d}的秩-r子空间上应用Fano型填充，证明了匹配的最小最大下界为Omega(rd/n)；该界适用于任何输出位于秩-r LoRA类中的估计器。结合这两个结果，得到秩选择二分法。对于约束经验风险最小化器，最优秩等于内在秩r*，过度秩化会严格损害性能。对于核范数后截断类型的自适应估计器，过度秩化无危害，且无论r如何，速率饱和于Theta~(r* d / n)。综合来看，这三个结果在局部二次框架内刻画了LoRA微调的统计复杂性，并将经验观察到的过度参数化惩罚归因于非正则化的经验风险最小化，而非LoRA类别本身。理论预测在合成追踪回归基准以及跨越三个（模型、任务）配置的真实LoRA微调中得到了验证，这些配置涵盖了DistilBERT和RoBERTa在SST-2和MRPC上的微调。所有配置在验证损失中均表现出预测的U形，其中两个在大秩下显示出统计上显著的损失膨胀（配对置换p = 0.016）。

articles.title: ICLE++: Modeling Fine-Grained Traits for Holistic Essay Scoring
articles.abstract: The majority of the recently-developed models for automated essay scoring (AES) are evaluated solely on the ASAP corpus. However, ASAP is not without its limitations. For instance, it is not clear whether models trained on ASAP can generalize well when evaluated on other corpora. In light of these limitations, we introduce ICLE++, a corpus of persuasive student essays annotated with both holistic scores and trait-specific scores. Not only can ICLE++ be used to test the generalizability of AES models trained on ASAP, but it can also facilitate the evaluation of models developed for newer AES problems such as multi-trait scoring and cross-prompt scoring. We believe that ICLE++, which represents a culmination of our long-term effort in annotating the essays in the ICLE corpus, contributes to the set of much-needed annotated corpora for AES research.
articles.comment: Accepted as a long paper to NAACL 2024
articles.titleCn: ICLE++：用于整体作文评分的细粒度特征建模
articles.abstractCn: 目前大多数自动化作文评分（AES）模型仅在ASAP语料库上进行了评估。然而，ASAP语料库并非没有局限性。例如，尚不清楚在ASAP上训练的模型在其他语料库上的评估中能否具有良好的泛化能力。鉴于这些局限性，我们引入了ICLE++，这是一个包含论说性学生作文的语料库，并标注了整体评分和特质特定评分。ICLE++不仅可以用于测试在ASAP上训练的AES模型的泛化能力，还可以促进针对新型AES问题（如多特质评分和跨提示评分）所开发模型的评估。我们相信，ICLE++代表了我们长期标注ICLE语料库作文的努力成果，为AES研究提供了急需的标注语料库。

articles.title: Looped Transformers with Source-Centered State Evolution
articles.abstract: Looped Transformers create a useful train- and test-time compute axis by reusing the same Transformer block over recurrent depth, increasing effective depth at a fixed parameter count. However, that shared block must then govern an entire trajectory of varying hidden states over trained and extrapolated depths. Furthermore, in additive-injection looped Transformers, an input-conditioned signal is reintroduced at every recurrent step, so applying the shared transition at an input-conditioned reference can still move the hidden state. In this paper, we propose Source-Centered State Evolution (SCSE), which is designed to reconcile input conditioning with reference-preserving shared recurrence. Specifically, SCSE retains input dependence through its learned anchor and initial deviation, allows nonzero deviations to drive recurrent computation while mapping zero deviation to zero, and guarantees exact anchor invariance through its zero-deviation mask. The designated anchor is thereby a one-step fixed point by construction. The zero-deviation forcing bias is the next deviation produced from the anchor itself and vanishes in SCSE, while nonzero deviations remain active and support state-dependent recurrent computation. Our theory shows that the zero-deviation forcing bias is a design degree of freedom whose task effect can be harmful, neutral, or beneficial; SCSE resolves this choice in favor of exact anchor invariance by setting the bias to zero. Across WikiText-2, WikiText-103, direct web-corpus pretraining, held-out web-text transfer, and LAMBADA completion, SCSE improves the controlled recurrent quality frontier. Ablation studies identify the learned anchor and the anchor-coordinate deviation recurrence as the primary contributors to the gain, and a trained-model case study grounds the anchor-response diagnostic in observed recurrent motion.
articles.titleCn: 基于源中心的循环Transformer状态演化
articles.abstractCn: 循环Transformer通过在循环深度上重用相同的Transformer块，创建了一个有用的训练和测试时计算轴，从而在固定的参数数量下增加了有效深度。然而，这个共享块必须控制整个训练和扩展深度上变化的隐藏状态轨迹。此外，在加性注入循环Transformer中，输入条件信号在每个循环步骤中重新引入，因此即使在输入条件参考上应用共享转换仍然可以移动隐藏状态。在本文中，我们提出了以源为中心的状态演化（SCSE），旨在协调输入条件与参考保留的共享循环。具体来说，SCSE通过其学习到的锚点和初始偏差保留输入依赖性，允许非零偏差驱动循环计算，同时将零偏差映射为零，并通过其零偏差掩码保证精确的锚点不变性。因此，指定的锚点通过构造成为一步固定点。零偏差强制偏差是从锚点本身产生的下一个偏差，在SCSE中消失，而非零偏差保持活跃并支持状态相关的循环计算。我们的理论表明，零偏差强制偏差是一个设计自由度，其任务效果可以是有害的、中性的或有益的；SCSE通过将偏差设为零，在精确锚点不变性的选择上解决了这个问题。在WikiText-2、WikiText-103、直接网络语料库预训练、保留的网页文本迁移和LAMBADA完成中，SCSE提高了受控循环质量前沿。消融研究确定了学习到的锚点和锚点坐标偏差循环是增益的主要贡献者，而训练模型案例研究将锚点响应诊断与观察到的循环运动相结合。

articles.title: From Single- to Cross-Document: Benchmarking Multi-Granularity Event Analysis of Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Event analysis is an essential and fundamental direction of information extraction, involving various event-centric tasks at different granularity of documents. While large language models (LLMs) have preliminarily achieved promising performance in part of these tasks individually, their capability in event analysis still lacks comprehensive understanding due to restricted document granularity, task designs, and data source of existing benchmarks. To address these limitations, we introduce MiGUE-Bench, a systematic benchmark for assessing the performance of LLMs in multi-granularity event analysis. To support large-scale evaluation, we first develop an LLM-driven self-correcting annotation framework called MiGUE-Pipeline, enabling scalable acquisition of high-quality source data of events with automatic labels. Then, we design four core tasks in our benchmark, i.e., event detection, relation reasoning, structure induction, and future prediction, to probe model competence at different levels, from atomic event details to complex cross-document narratives. Extensive experiments on state-of-the-art LLMs and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods delineate the current capability boundary and identify critical deficiencies, providing insights into the future improvement of LLMs in challenging event analysis tasks.
articles.comment: 9 pages. Published in the Proceedings of the 49th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval (SIGIR 2026)
articles.titleCn: 从单文档到跨文档：大型语言模型多粒度事件分析的基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 事件分析是信息抽取领域的一项关键且基础的方向，涉及不同文档粒度下的各类以事件为中心的任务。尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）在部分这些任务中已初步取得了令人鼓舞的性能，但由于现有基准的文档粒度、任务设计和数据来源受限，其在事件分析方面的能力仍缺乏全面理解。为解决这些局限性，我们引入了MiGUE-Bench，这是一个用于评估LLMs在多粒度事件分析中性能的系统性基准。为支持大规模评估，我们首先开发了一个名为MiGUE-Pipeline的LLM驱动的自纠正标注框架，能够实现高质量事件源数据的可扩展获取以及自动标注。然后，我们在基准中设计了四个核心任务，即事件检测、关系推理、结构归纳和未来预测，以探究模型在不同层次上的能力，从原子事件细节到复杂的跨文档叙事。在当前最先进的LLMs和检索增强生成（RAG）方法上的大量实验描绘了当前的能力边界，并识别出关键缺陷，为LLMs在具有挑战性的事件分析任务中的未来改进提供了见解。

articles.title: Harness-G: A Graph-Structured Harness for Search Agents
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) search agents commonly model retrieval as free-form natural-language query generation and optimize multi-turn interactions using final-answer rewards. Current studies mainly improve training with denser or more structured credit signals, but rarely examine whether retrieval is properly formulated at the policy-environment interface. We observe pronounced retrieval aliasing during Search-R1 training: rollouts for the same question continue to generate distinct query strings, yet their accumulated evidence sets increasingly overlap. We call this phenomenon retrieval-equivalence collapse; in this regime, trajectories approach utility equivalence with respect to retrieval decisions, leaving within-group returns with little effective retrieval contrast. To address this problem, we propose Harness-G, a graph-structured retrieval framework that redesigns this interface. It reformulates free-form query generation as finite action selection: the policy selects an evidence sentence or entity, or chooses to answer, while the environment constructs the menu, tracks retrieval state, and validates and executes each choice. This interface reduces linguistic aliasing and makes same-state alternatives directly comparable. Building on this interface, we introduce Structured Non-myopic Credit (SNC), which uses a frozen answer scorer to compare the selected action with its alternatives and assigns downstream gains to the earlier actions that enabled them. Across six QA benchmarks, Harness-G achieves the highest average F1 at both evaluated model scales, outperforming the strongest baseline, Graph-R1, by 10.74 points at 1.5B and 3.98 points at 3B.
articles.titleCn: Harness-G：一种用于搜索代理的图结构 harness
articles.abstractCn: 强化学习（RL）搜索代理通常将检索建模为自由形式的自然语言查询生成，并使用最终答案奖励优化多轮交互。当前研究主要通过更密集或更结构化的信用信号来改进训练，但很少检查检索是否在策略-环境接口中正确表述。我们在Search-R1训练过程中观察到明显的检索别名现象：针对同一问题的 rollout 继续生成不同的查询字符串，但其累积的证据集却越来越多地重叠。我们将这种现象称为检索等价崩溃；在这种状态下，轨迹在检索决策方面接近效用等价，导致组内回报几乎缺乏有效的检索对比。为解决这个问题，我们提出了 Harness-G，一个图结构检索框架，重新设计了这一接口。它将自由形式的查询生成重新表述为有限动作选择：策略选择一个证据句子或实体，或选择回答，而环境构建菜单、跟踪检索状态，并验证和执行每个选择。这个接口减少了语言别名，并使相同状态下的替代方案可以直接比较。基于这个接口，我们引入了结构化非近视信用（SNC），它使用一个冻结的答案评分器来比较所选动作及其替代方案，并将下游收益分配给使它们成为可能的早期动作。在六个问答基准测试中，Harness-G 在两个评估模型规模下均实现了最高的平均 F1 分数，在 1.5B 规模下比最强的基线 Graph-R1 高出 10.74 分，在 3B 规模下高出 3.98 分。

articles.title: ReDiPPO: Reference-Guided Value Calibration and Discrepancy-Aware Token Reweighting for Mathematical Reasoning
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning has emerged as an effective paradigm for enhancing the mathematical reasoning capabilities of large language models. Among existing policy optimization methods, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) remains particularly appealing because its learned critic can, in principle, provide token-level credit assignment. However, in mathematical reasoning tasks characterized by long reasoning horizons and sparse outcome rewards, reliable token-level credit assignment remains challenging. The standard critic often fails to accurately evaluate intermediate reasoning states, resulting in noisy advantage estimates and suboptimal policy updates. In this paper, we propose ReDiPPO, a Reference-guided and Discrepancy-aware PPO framework for mathematical reasoning. ReDiPPO introduces a reference-guided critic that uses reference answers as training-time privileged signals to provide more accurate value estimation. Meanwhile, it retains a standard critic and quantifies the token-level reference-standard discrepancy between the standard value estimate and the reference-guided value estimate. This discrepancy serves as an indicator of difficult reasoning states and is used to reweight the corresponding token-level advantages during PPO optimization. Extensive experiments on diverse mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that ReDiPPO improves value-estimation accuracy and consistently outperforms strong policy optimization baselines, including PPO, DAPO, and GSPO, in final reasoning performance. Our code is available on https://github.com/cii030/ReDiPPO.
articles.titleCn: ReDiPPO：参考引导值校准和差异感知标记重加权用于数学推理
articles.abstractCn: 强化学习已成为提升大型语言模型数学推理能力的一种有效范式。在现有的策略优化方法中，近端策略优化（PPO）因其学习到的评价者原则上能够提供标记级别的归因而显得尤为吸引人。然而，在具有长推理范围和稀疏结果奖励的数学推理任务中，可靠的标记级别归因仍然具有挑战性。标准评价者往往无法准确评估中间推理状态，导致优势估计存在噪声，策略更新次优。在本文中，我们提出了ReDiPPO，一个用于数学推理的参考引导和差异感知PPO框架。ReDiPPO引入了一个参考引导的评价者，该评价者使用参考答案作为训练时的特权信号，以提供更准确的价值估计。同时，它保留了标准评价者，并量化了标准价值估计与参考引导价值估计之间的标记级别参考-标准差异。这种差异作为困难推理状态的指标，用于在PPO优化过程中重新加权相应的标记级别优势。在多种数学推理基准测试上的大量实验表明，ReDiPPO提高了价值估计的准确性，并在最终推理性能方面始终优于PPO、DAPO和GSPO等强大的策略优化基线。我们的代码可在https://github.com/cii030/ReDiPPO上获取。

articles.title: DualAnchor: Preserving Language Priors and Improving Lexical Fidelity in Gloss-Free Sign Language Translation
articles.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have led sign language translation (SLT), the task of converting sign-language videos into spoken-language text, to increasingly adopt LLMs as textual backbones. However, despite their strong language modeling capabilities, existing LLM-based SLT methods often undermine rather than exploit this language prior, producing disfluent translations, a failure we term language-prior degradation. Meanwhile, existing methods typically align videos and text at the sentence level, which does not ensure accurate lexical details and creates a lexical fidelity gap. To address both issues, we propose DualAnchor, a gloss-free LLM-based SLT training framework that couples two complementary anchors for linguistically fluent and visually faithful generation. Token-level Prior Anchoring (TPA) preserves the LLM's language prior by regularizing the multimodal decoder at each decoding step toward the next-token distribution of a frozen LLM conditioned on the same autoregressive prefix. Optimal Transport Alignment (OTA) improves lexical fidelity by formulating visual-textual matching as entropy-regularized partial optimal transport, with Sinkhorn optimization inducing a soft alignment between visual tokens and textual content tokens under a cosine cost. DualAnchor achieves strong overall performance on both PHOENIX-2014T and CSL-Daily. Targeted analyses attribute these gains to the complementary effects of the two anchors: TPA improves fluency, whereas OTA reduces fine-grained lexical errors.
articles.titleCn: 双锚点：在无文字手语翻译中保留语言先验并提升词汇保真度
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）的最新进展使得手语翻译（SLT），即将手语视频转换为口语文本的任务，越来越多地采用LLM作为文本基础。然而，尽管现有基于LLM的手语翻译方法具有强大的语言建模能力，它们往往削弱而非利用这种语言先验，导致不流畅的翻译，我们将这种失败称为语言先验退化。同时，现有方法通常在句子级别对视频和文本进行对齐，这无法确保准确的词汇细节，并造成了词汇保真度差距。为解决这两个问题，我们提出了DualAnchor，这是一个无注释的基于LLM的手语翻译训练框架，它结合了两个互补的锚点，以实现语言流畅和视觉忠实的生成。标记级先验锚定（TPA）通过在每个解码步骤中正则化多模态解码器，使其朝向冻结的LLM在相同自回归前缀条件下的下一个标记分布，从而保留LLM的语言先验。最优传输对齐（OTA）通过将视觉-文本匹配表述为熵正则化的部分最优传输，提高了词汇保真度，Sinkhorn优化在余弦成本下在视觉标记和文本内容标记之间诱导了软对齐。DualAnchor在PHOENIX-2014T和CSL-Daily上均取得了优异的整体性能。针对性分析归因于两个锚点的互补效应：TPA提高了流畅性，而OTA减少了细粒度的词汇错误。

articles.title: AWARE-FX: An Auditable Knowledge-Guided AI System for Measuring Corporate Foreign-Exchange Hedging Disclosure
articles.abstract: Corporate annual reports contain weakly structured evidence about foreign-exchange risk management, derivative use, natural hedging, and explicit non-use. This study develops AWARE-FX, an auditable AI/NLP decision-support system that converts report text into traceable firm-year hedging-disclosure measures. The system combines a professional-source lexicon, negation and accounting-status logic, channel-specific financial encoders, exact evidence gates, conservative aggregation, and an audit ledger. Across 24,909 Hong Kong firm-years from 2008-2025, it retrieves and scores 543,527 snippets. Reliability is evaluated through ablations, a stratified 300-snippet human audit, three-seed FinBERT-ModernBERT comparisons, strict 2023-2025 temporal tests, probability calibration, selective prediction, and fixed-prompt generative-model benchmarks. FinBERT has the higher mean F1 in seven of eight encoder task-split comparisons; its temporal F1 ranges from 0.702 to 0.872. Abstaining on the 20% least-confident temporal observations raises retained-sample F1 by 0.050-0.077. Deterministic Qwen3-8B performs strongly on commodity and negation evidence but poorly on foreign-debt and accounting-context labels, showing that a general-purpose LLM does not uniformly replace domain constraints. The strict FX score is negatively associated with linked baseline and stress-period FX exposure, whereas the generic broad score is not. These associations provide external construct validation, not causal estimates of hedging effectiveness. AWARE-FX contributes a tested decision-support architecture in which retrieval, status logic, classification, uncertainty handling, aggregation, and external validation remain separately auditable.

articles.titleCn: AWARE-FX：一种用于衡量企业外汇套期保值披露的可审计知识引导型人工智能系统
articles.abstractCn: 企业年度报告包含关于外汇风险管理、衍生品使用、自然对冲和明确不使用的结构化程度较弱证据。本研究开发了一种可审计的AI/NLP决策支持系统AWARE-FX，该系统将报告文本转换为可追溯的企业-年度对冲披露指标。该系统结合了专业来源词汇库、否定和会计状态逻辑、特定渠道的金融编码器、精确证据门控、保守聚合和审计账本。在2008-2025年的24,909家香港企业-年度数据中，系统检索并评分了543,527个片段。通过消融实验、分层300片段人工审计、三种子集FinBERT-ModernBERT比较、严格2023-2025年时序测试、概率校准、选择性预测和固定提示生成模型基准测试评估了可靠性。FinBERT在八种子集编码器任务比较中七个表现更高，其时序F1值介于0.702至0.872。对最不自信的20%时序观测值进行回避处理，可提高保留样本F1值0.050-0.077。确定性Qwen3-8B在商品和否定证据上表现强劲，但在外债和会计背景标签上表现不佳，表明通用大语言模型不能完全替代领域约束。严格的FX评分与关联基线和压力期FX敞口呈负相关，而通用宽泛评分则无此关联。这些关联提供了外部结构效度验证，而非对冲有效性的因果估计。AWARE-FX贡献了一种经过测试的决策支持架构，其中检索、状态逻辑、分类、不确定性处理、聚合和外部效度验证均保持独立可审计。

articles.title: Beyond Similarity: Grounded Agentic Extraction and Expert-Adjudicated Evaluation of Intertextuality in Classical Chinese Histories
articles.abstract: Computational approaches to intertextuality have advanced from string matching to neural retrieval, yet their outputs, similarity scores and parallel-passage lists, identify where texts reuse one another without characterizing how or why. We recast fine-grained intertextuality extraction as an agentic task in which a large language model (LLM) reads two text units in full and, through a constrained tool interface, must ground each proposed reuse in exact character spans on both sides and label it under a five-dimension typology of reuse (form, aspect, source-marking, function, stance). We validate the approach on an exhaustive comparison of the Analects with the Book of Han, where three domain experts adjudicate a pooled multi-model candidate set into a benchmark of 2,533 intertextual pairs. Against this standard we study twelve LLMs, reporting precision (56%-93%), a 51$\times$ cost spread at comparable quality, and how well their confidence is calibrated. Expert agreement traces a reliability gradient: dimensions legible on the textual surface are annotated consistently, while those requiring inference of intent are contested, delimiting the claims such annotation supports. Scaling the validated extractor to the full Twenty-Four Histories (65,380 comparisons, 5,766 pairs) recovers corpus-level structure a similarity score cannot express. The interpretive composition of citation shows no systematic change across eighteen centuries, yet the same passage is quoted less and less literally. Stability in the aggregate with drift in the individual case is what a cultural-attraction account expects. We release the extraction protocol and the expert-adjudicated benchmark.
articles.titleCn: 超越相似性：基于根基的能动提取与专家裁定评价古典中文历史中的互文性
articles.abstractCn: 计算方法在互文性研究上已从字符串匹配发展到神经检索，但其输出结果——相似度分数和并行段落列表——仅能识别文本间相互引用的位置，却无法揭示其引用方式或原因。我们将细粒度互文性提取重构为一个代理任务，其中大型语言模型（LLM）需完整阅读两个文本单元，并通过约束工具界面，将每项提出的引用依据精确的字符跨度进行锚定，并按照五种引用维度类型（形式、方面、来源标记、功能、立场）进行标注。我们在《论语》与《汉书》的全面对比中验证了该方法，其中三位领域专家从多模型候选集中裁定出2,533对互文性基准对。基于此标准，我们研究了十二个LLM，报告了其精确度（56%-93%），在相似质量下的51倍成本差异，以及其置信度的校准情况。专家共识揭示了一种可靠性梯度：文本表面可识别的维度标注一致，而需要推断意图的维度则存在争议，从而界定了此类标注所支持的主张。将验证过的提取器扩展到全部二十四史（65,380次比较，5,766对），能够揭示相似度分数无法表达的语料库级结构。引文的解释性组合在十八个世纪中未出现系统性变化，但相同段落被引用得越来越不直接。整体上的稳定性与个案中的漂移正是文化吸引力解释所预期的现象。我们发布了提取协议和专家裁定基准。

articles.title: Prox: Training-Free FFN Activation Sparsity via Approximate Intermediate-Channel Salience in LLMs
articles.abstract: Feed-forward networks (FFNs) dominate memory traffic and computation in large language model (LLM) inference, making them a primary target for activation sparsification. However, existing training-free methods suffer substantial model-quality degradation at high sparsity due to limitations in their channel-selection strategies. We observe that the SwiGLU intermediate state provides a highly effective channel-selection signal, but obtaining it requires costly dense computation. To address this, we present \emph{Prox}, a two-stage training-free framework for sparse SwiGLU FFNs. Prox hinges on the key insight: sparse execution requires only the channel mask induced by the intermediate state, which can be constructed from the magnitude ranking of its entries rather than their exact values. Specifically, Stage 1 uses input sparsity and quantized proxy weights to construct a shared mask; Stage 2 computes the selected channels exactly, enabling sparse execution of all three projections. Across ten LLMs from six model families, Prox outperforms training-free baselines at all sparsity levels, achieves up to a $1.99\times$ end-to-end decoding speedup at 70\% FFN sparsity, and is compatible with quantization and sparse attention.
articles.titleCn: Prox：基于LLM中近似中间通道显著性实现的无需训练的FFN激活稀疏性
articles.abstractCn: 前馈网络（FFNs）主导着大型语言模型（LLM）推理中的内存流量和计算，使其成为激活稀疏化的主要目标。然而，现有的无训练方法在高稀疏度下会因信道选择策略的局限性而导致模型质量显著下降。我们观察到，SwiGLU中间状态提供了一个非常有效的信道选择信号，但获取它需要昂贵的密集计算。为此，我们提出了Prox，一个用于稀疏SwiGLU FFN的两阶段无训练框架。Prox基于一个关键洞察：稀疏执行只需要由中间状态诱导的信道掩码，该掩码可以从其条目的幅度排序而非精确值构建。具体而言，第一阶段利用输入稀疏性和量化代理权重来构建共享掩码；第二阶段精确计算所选信道，从而实现三个投影的稀疏执行。在六个模型家族的十个LLM中，Prox在所有稀疏度级别上都优于无训练基线，在70% FFN稀疏度下实现了高达1.99倍的端到端解码加速，并且兼容量化和稀疏注意力。

articles.title: Training Skills Like Parameters via Self-Supervised Semantic Diffusion
articles.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable general instruction-following capabilities, they often fall short of human experts in highly specialized, open-ended domains such as creative screenwriting. Prior approaches typically adopt post-training, yet both supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning require weight access that closed-source frontier models do not offer, and demand heavy compute. Moreover, what is learned is tied to a single checkpoint and cannot be inspected by humans. Recent advancements in agentic continual learning instead attempt to bridge this gap by accumulating external textual skills. However, these methods heavily rely on costly human expert annotations or unreliable LLM-as-a-judge feedback for reflection. To overcome this bottleneck, we propose a novel, unsupervised self-evolving agent framework inspired by the corruption-and-reconstruction paradigm of diffusion models. Instead of relying on explicit external scoring, we leverage existing high-quality human artifacts to construct self-supervised signals. Training then follows the familiar loop of neural network training, forward, loss, and backward, with the loss coming from contrasting the agent's reconstruction against the human original. What is updated is not model weights but an external library of textual skills. We evaluate our framework on the challenging task of short drama screenwriting. Experimental results demonstrate that our method enables the agent to autonomously extract and internalize highly generalizable skills, significantly enhancing its domain-specific generation capabilities. Furthermore, this self-contrastive reflection paradigm offers a scalable pathway for agents to teach themselves the production of complex, high-quality human artifacts, without requiring external supervision.
articles.titleCn: 通过自监督语义扩散来训练技能如同训练参数
articles.abstractCn: 尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）展现出卓越的通用指令遵循能力，但在高度专业化、开放式的领域（如创意剧本创作）中，它们往往不及人类专家。以往方法通常采用训练后处理，但无论是监督微调还是强化学习，都需要访问权重，而闭源的边界模型不提供这种访问权限，并且需要大量的计算资源。此外，所学习的内容与单个检查点绑定，且无法被人类检查。近期在代理式持续学习方面的进展尝试通过积累外部文本技能来弥合这一差距。然而，这些方法严重依赖昂贵的人类专家标注或不可靠的将LLM作为裁判的反馈进行反思。为了克服这一瓶颈，我们提出了一种受扩散模型中的损坏与重建范式启发的全新无监督自进化代理框架。我们不是依赖明确的外部评分，而是利用现有的高质量人类作品来构建自监督信号。训练遵循神经网络训练的熟悉循环：前向传播、损失计算和反向传播，其中损失来自于将代理的重建与人类原始作品进行对比。更新的不是模型权重，而是一个外部文本技能库。我们在具有挑战性的短剧剧本创作任务上评估了我们的框架。实验结果表明，我们的方法使代理能够自主提取并内化具有高度泛化能力的技能，显著增强了其在特定领域的生成能力。此外，这种自对比反思范式为代理提供了一条可扩展的途径，使其能够在无需外部监督的情况下自学复杂、高质量的人类作品的生成。

articles.title: AI and Its Impact on Creativity and Diversity: An Empirical Study of LLM-Generated Product Ideas
articles.abstract: This research examines how well large language models, or LLMs, generate new product ideas for college students priced under $50. Across a series of studies, we identify key strengths and weaknesses of using LLMs for product innovation. Our first study shows that LLM-generated product ideas have higher average quality than human ideas, based on purchase intent, and are 7 times more likely to rank in the top 10%. Our second study shows that this AI-induced creativity boost is not explained by the LLM's more persuasive pitching skills. Our third and fourth studies identify a weakness of using LLMs for brainstorming: AI-generated ideas are less novel at the idea level and less diverse at the set level. In our fifth study, we analyze prior LLM-based creativity studies and find consistently lower idea diversity across all of them, demonstrating the generalizability of these findings. Our sixth and seventh studies investigate techniques to mitigate this diversity loss. We compare LLMs from different vendors and versions and find that more recent models generate more diverse ideas, though they still fall short of human-level diversity. We also demonstrate techniques that increase idea diversity almost to the level of human idea generation: pooling ideas across vendors; prompt engineering, including Chain-of-Thought prompting and injecting heterogeneous personas or constraints; and creative agents that broadly explore the solution landscape to restore diversity. Finally, in our eighth study, we show that exploiting the near-zero marginal cost of AI idea generation by scaling the number of ideas steadily improves coverage of the idea space, approaching human-level coverage. We conclude by presenting actionable recommendations for innovation managers who want to identify better new product ideas with the help of LLMs.
articles.titleCn: 人工智能及其对创造力和多样性的影响：对大型语言模型生成产品想法的实证研究
articles.abstractCn: 本研究探讨了大型语言模型（LLM）为价格低于50美元的大学学生生成新产品创意的效果。通过一系列研究，我们识别了使用LLM进行产品创新的优缺点。我们的首项研究表明，基于购买意愿，LLM生成的产品创意平均质量高于人类创意，且排名进入前10%的可能性高出7倍。第二项研究显示，这种AI驱动的创造力提升并非源于LLM更具说服力的提案技巧。第三项和第四项研究指出了使用LLM进行头脑风暴的弱点：AI生成的创意在创意层面新颖性不足，在集合层面多样性较低。第五项研究分析了以往的基于LLM的创造力研究，发现所有研究中的创意多样性均持续偏低，证明了这些发现的普适性。第六项和第七项研究调查了缓解这种多样性损失的技术。我们比较了不同供应商和版本的LLM，发现较新的模型生成的创意更多样，但仍不及人类水平的多样性。我们还展示了提升创意多样性的技术：跨供应商整合创意；提示工程，包括思维链提示和注入异质角色或约束；以及能够广泛探索解决方案空间以恢复多样性的创意代理。最后，在第八项研究中，我们展示了通过逐步增加创意数量来利用AI创意生成的近零边际成本，从而持续提升创意空间的覆盖范围，接近人类水平的覆盖。我们最终为希望借助LLM识别更好新产品创意的创新管理者提出了可操作的推荐建议。

articles.title: Subtract or Replay? Exact Deletion from Language-Model Memory
articles.abstract: Exact deletion from persistent language-model memory depends on how that memory represents a record. Addressable influence can be removed by algebraic decrement; influence transformed by later writes inside shared recurrent state requires rebuilding from before the write. We test this distinction in two pretrained models against explicit record-omitted references. First, we replace Gemma 3's global-attention layers with support-vector memory. After low-rank recovery at 1B, decrement and retained-key refit agree at the next-token output to median KL $5.4\times10^{-15}$ over 31 support-token deletions, with $+2.0\%$ perplexity relative to a matched fine-tune. A masked-refit proxy is indistinguishable from the never-ingested floor under elicitation, relearning, sampling, and LiRA attacks. At 4B and 12B, certificate ordering persists but utility cost rises to $11.2\%$ and $44.3\%$. Second, in a 48B Kimi Linear hybrid, additive writes admit a fixed decrement and diagonal decay a corrected one, whereas the delta rule makes $12$--$49\%$ of a record's contribution suffix-dependent. Checkpointed rewind-and-replay deletes real clinical records at contexts up to 18,842 tokens, matching never-ingested logits and all recurrent states bit for bit within a deterministic MLX implementation; replaying a correction provides exact amendment. Exact deletion is therefore a property of memory representation: subtract addressable records and replay entangled writes.
articles.titleCn: 减去还是重播？语言模型记忆中的精确删除
articles.abstractCn: 从持久语言模型记忆中精确删除取决于该记忆如何表示记录。可寻址影响可以通过代数减法移除；由共享循环状态中后期写入转换的影响需要从写入前重新构建。我们在两个预训练模型中针对明确的记录省略参考测试这一区别。首先，我们用支持向量记忆替换Gemma 3的全局注意力层。在1B的低秩恢复后，减法和保留键重新拟合在下一个词输出上对31个支持词删除的中值KL散度达到$5.4\times10^{-15}$，与匹配微调相比困惑度上升$+2.0\%$。掩码重新拟合代理与从未被吸收的底部在提示、再学习、采样和LiRA攻击下无法区分。在4B和12B时，证书顺序仍然存在，但效用成本上升到$11.2\%$和$44.3\%$。其次，在一个48B Kimi Linear混合模型中，加性写入允许固定减法，而对角线衰减允许修正的减法，而增量规则使记录贡献的12%--49%依赖于后缀。检查点回滚重放删除了最多18,842个词上下文中的真实临床记录，匹配了从未被吸收的logits和所有循环状态，在确定性MLX实现中逐位匹配；重放一个修正提供了精确的修正。因此，精确删除是记忆表示的特性：减去可寻址记录并重放纠缠写入。
